articles.title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
articles.abstract: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. Inspired by this, we propose ToolSmith, an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library. We evaluate ToolSmith on three in-domain multimodal search benchmarks and ten out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol. ToolSmith consistently improves over the base library across deployed agents of varying scales, with larger backbones reaping greater gains, demonstrating the scalability of the approach. Our code and data are available at https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/.
articles.titleCn: ToolSmith：面向多模态搜索代理的自动工具生成框架
articles.abstractCn: 最新的多模态搜索代理通过推理、视觉和跨多轮的实时网络搜索，在参数化知识之外回答问题，它们协调一个小型手工艺搜索和视觉工具库。然而，这个库创建和维护起来费时费力，一旦遇到新的查询类型、证据格式和现实中的失败模式就会冻结。相比之下，人类从业者通过从熟悉的部件中创造新工具并跨任务重复使用它们来应对工具不足的问题。受此启发，我们提出了ToolSmith，一个自动工具生成框架，它在一个精简的基础工具库之上扩展和重用模块。我们在三个领域内的多模态搜索基准和十个领域外的基准上，在VLM-as-a-Judge协议下评估了ToolSmith。ToolSmith在规模不同的部署代理中始终优于基础库，更大的主干网络获得了更大的收益，证明了该方法的可扩展性。我们的代码和数据可在https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/获取。

articles.title: CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. We introduce CO-GRAFT, a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate a single trajectory under closed-loop execution with live retrieval. Each policy controls a mutually exclusive subset of four functional roles: intermediate reasoning, search-or-answer decision, search query generation, and final answer extraction. Evaluating all 2^4=16 role assignments without modifying weights or retraining defines a cooperative game whose Shapley values decompose the total RL gain across roles, while M"obius interaction terms distinguish standalone role improvements from multi-role coupling. Applying CO-GRAFT to Search-R1 agents across Qwen2.5 and Llama-3.2 models (spanning two sizes, base and instruction-tuned initializations, GRPO and PPO optimizers, and NQ and HotpotQA datasets), we show that query generation never exceeds 15% of the total gain; instead, gains are governed by pre-RL answer validity, search retention, model scale, and fixed task-level search budgets, shifting credit from reasoning toward answer extraction in larger or well-formatted answer response checkpoints while smaller base models rely on reasoning--decision coupling.
articles.titleCn: 协同嫁接：通过角色级策略嫁接在搜索代理中归因强化学习收益
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习（RL）使大型语言模型搜索代理在精确匹配（EM）指标上提升了高达32个点，但其整体准确率的提升并未揭示在训练过程中哪些底层功能能力得到了改进或相互作用。我们引入了CO-GRAFT，这是一个与奖励无关的干预归因框架，其中经过RL训练的代理及其RL初始化在闭环执行与实时检索下共同生成单一轨迹。每个策略控制一组互斥的四个功能角色：中间推理、搜索或回答决策、搜索查询生成以及最终答案提取。通过在不修改权重或重新训练的情况下评估所有2^4=16种角色分配，定义了一个合作博弈，其Shapley值将总RL增益分解到各个角色上，而Möbius交互项则区分了独立角色改进与多角色耦合。将CO-GRAFT应用于跨Qwen2.5和Llama-3.2模型（涵盖两种规模、基础和指令微调初始化、GRPO和PPO优化器、NQ和HotpotQA数据集）的Search-R1代理，我们发现查询生成从未超过总增益的15%；相反，增益受控于RL前的答案有效性、搜索保留、模型规模和固定的任务级搜索预算，在较大或格式良好的答案响应检查点中，信用从推理转向答案提取，而较小的基础模型则依赖推理-决策耦合。

articles.title: Precision-Aware Learning Rate Transfer Across Block Count in LLM Post-Training
articles.abstract: The post-training of pretrained large language models, including supervised finetuning (SFT), direct preference optimization (DPO), and reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR), is very sensitive to the learning rate, and tuning it through grid search is costly in both computation and memory. In this work, we propose \textbf{TipSweep}, a method to transfer the learning rate across the number of trainable transformer blocks. To do so efficiently, we search for the best learning rate by training only the last $k_0$ blocks (in our experiments, typically $k_0=1$), and provide scaling rules that predict the optimal learning rate when training any set of $k$ blocks, including when $k=L$ (the full transformer). Across experiments with models ranging from 1 to 7 billion parameters, we observe that the optimal learning rate follows precision-dependent scaling rules: the optimal rate scales approximately as $k^{-1}$ with float32 (FP32) master weights, but as $k^{-1/2}$ when updates are applied directly to bfloat16 (BF16) weights without a master copy. We explain both rules using an analytical model that accounts for update rounding, under assumptions supported by profiling experiments. Finally, we develop two prototypes of the learning rate search for a 6.7-billion-parameter model. The first fits the search on a single consumer GPU with 16 GiB of memory. The second speeds up the search on a high-end GPU by evaluating all candidate learning rates in a single pass over the data, so that a five-candidate search takes about half the GPU hours of one full-depth ($k=L$) run.
articles.titleCn: 基于块数量的LLM微调后精度感知学习率迁移
articles.abstractCn: 预训练大型语言模型的后续训练，包括监督微调（SFT）、直接偏好优化（DPO）和可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），对学习率非常敏感，通过网格搜索调整学习率在计算和内存上都非常昂贵。在这项工作中，我们提出了 \textbf{TipSweep}，一种将学习率跨可训练的Transformer块数进行迁移的方法。为了高效实现这一点，我们通过仅训练最后 $k_0$ 个块（在我们的实验中，通常 $k_0=1$）来搜索最佳学习率，并提供缩放规则，以预测训练任意 $k$ 个块时的最佳学习率，包括当 $k=L$（整个Transformer）。在参数范围从1到70亿的模型实验中，我们观察到最佳学习率遵循与精度相关的缩放规则：当使用float32（FP32）主权重时，最佳率大约按 $k^{-1}$ 缩放；但在直接将更新应用于bfloat16（BF16）权重而不使用主副本时，最佳率按 $k^{-1/2}$ 缩放。我们使用一个考虑更新舍入的分析模型解释了这两条规则，该模型基于性能分析实验的假设。最后，我们为6.7亿参数模型开发了两种学习率搜索的原型。第一个在单个16 GiB内存的消费级GPU上运行搜索。第二个通过在一次数据遍历中评估所有候选学习率来加速高端GPU上的搜索，使得五候选搜索大约只需完整深度（$k=L$）运行一半的GPU小时。

articles.title: Deneb-Vritra: Descriptions, Edges and Names Examined by Blocking Via Restoring Token Representations and Attention
articles.abstract: Laya is a 421M-parameter encoder that answers a question about a text in one pass: each answer option, written as a name plus a description, gets a marker token, and one score is read from the network at each marker. We first confirm that such models can follow an option's name when it contradicts the description; the question is where in the network this happens. We locate it. On 951 synthetic questions we move each name onto another option's description and count how often the model picks the option with the right name (the name shortcut): 53% for the released checkpoint, 59% for our fine-tune v1, 11% for a fine-tune with name randomisation. On a 320-item sample, blocking attention from each marker to its own name tokens in layers 14 to 17 of 28 cuts v1's shortcut from 67% to 16% (19% on two schemas held out from component selection) while accuracy with the original names stays at 90%; blocking marker edges to the question, other options or text has no effect. No single head matters (largest effect 9 points), and restoring clean marker states undoes the swap from layer 16. Attention mass tracks the window by layer but not by head. Repeated on 5 checkpoints (released, fine-tuned, name-randomised, and a pair trained without two schemas), the knockout finds similar layers; in the name-randomised ones, blocking the description edges instead brings the shortcut back to 56-58%, so the read persists and is outvoted. Marker states decode the name from layer 0; a one-direction probe erasure changed nothing but was weaker than a random edit. Copying layers 0-13 or 14-27 of a name-randomised sibling into a fine-tune recovers 66% and 65% (v1); 21% and 45% (pair A) of its shortcut reduction. 9 of the 12 predictions we could score, written before running, failed. Head sweeps cover 5 of 5 checkpoints; data are synthetic and LLM-labelled; one architecture.
articles.titleCn: Deneb-Vritra：通过恢复标记表示和注意力机制进行阻塞的描述、边缘和名称分析
articles.abstractCn: Laya 是一个包含 421M 参数的编码器，它可以在一次遍历中回答有关文本的问题：每个答案选项，以名称加上描述的形式书写，都会获得一个标记符号，并在每个标记处从网络中读取一个分数。我们首先确认这类模型能够在选项名称与描述矛盾时遵循名称；问题在于这发生在网络的哪个位置。我们找到了这个位置。在 951 个合成问题中，我们将每个名称移动到另一个选项的描述上，并统计模型选择具有正确名称的选项（名称捷径）的频率：发布检查点的频率为 53%，我们微调 v1 的频率为 59%，名称随机化微调的频率为 11%。在一个包含 320 个项目的样本中，在第 14 到第 17 层（共 28 层）中，阻止每个标记对其自身名称标记的注意力，将 v1 的捷径从 67% 降低到 16%（在从组件选择中保留的两个方案上为 19%），而原始名称的准确率保持在 90%；阻止标记边到问题、其他选项或文本没有影响。没有单个注意力头是关键的（最大影响为 9 分），恢复干净的标记状态撤销了第 16 层的交换。注意力质量按层跟踪窗口，但不按头跟踪。在 5 个检查点（发布、微调、名称随机化以及一对未使用两个方案的训练模型）上重复实验，发现破坏点位于相似层；在名称随机化的模型中，阻止描述边反而使捷径恢复到 56-58%，因此读取操作仍然存在但被否决。标记状态从第 0 层解码名称；单向探测擦除没有改变效果但比随机编辑弱。将名称随机化同卵体的第 0-13 层或第 14-27 层复制到微调中，恢复了 66% 和 65%（v1）；21% 和 45%（A 对）的捷径减少。我们能够评分的 12 个预测中，有 9 个在运行前书写，均失败。注意力头覆盖了所有 5 个检查点；数据是合成的，由 LLM 标注；架构相同。

articles.title: Serialization and the Character-System: Measuring Narrative Concentration in French Fiction (1800--1940)
articles.abstract: Every novel divides a finite quantity of narrative attention among its characters, and whether the shape of that division, between a narrative organized around a single figure and one spread across a crowd, has a history is far less settled than the abundance of critical commentary on protagonists might suggest. We operationalize Woloch's notion of the character-system, the distribution of narrative attention across a novel's cast structured by the tension between "the one" and "the many", as the inequality (Gini coefficient) of the PageRank distribution over a character network. We trace this measure of structural concentration across 12,011 French novels published between 1800 and 1940, drawn from the Hors d'usage corpus of Gallica fiction. Over the long nineteenth century the trajectory is U-shaped, with concentration declining to a trough in the 1850s-1860s and rising again through the turn of the century. The change is small, comparable to the difference between a novel built on two co-equal protagonists and one built on a single protagonist, but it is robust to the character cutoff, corpus density, cast size, and author effects. Detective and adventure fiction are less concentrated than the average novel of their period. Literary history reads the roman-feuilleton either as the novel of a superior hero or as a form of proliferating episodes, and on this structural measure our results support the second reading. Across the age of the feuilleton (1840-1914), authors whose careers were structured by newspaper serialization distribute centrality more evenly than a literary control, net of period, genre, and canon. Because such claims are only as trustworthy as the networks they rest on, we also evaluate the extraction pipeline against manually annotated novels, at the levels of cast and character identity.

articles.titleCn: 序列化与字符系统：衡量1800-1940年法国小说叙事浓度的方法
articles.abstractCn: 每一部小说都在其人物之间分配有限的叙事注意力，而围绕单一人物或分散于人群的叙事结构分配形式是否具有历史，远不如对主人公的丰富评论所暗示的那样确定。我们将沃尔och的人物系统概念，即小说中由“个体”与“群体”之间的张力所构建的人物分配结构，操作化为人物网络中PageRank分布的不平等（基尼系数）。我们追踪这一结构集中度指标，考察了1800年至1940年间出版的12,011部法国小说，这些小说来自Gallica虚构作品的Hors d'usage语料库。在漫长的19世纪中，这一轨迹呈U形，集中度在1850-1860年代降至谷底，并在世纪之交再次上升。这种变化很小，相当于一部以两位同等主人公构建的小说与一部以单一主人公构建的小说之间的差异，但它对人物截止点、语料库密度、人物规模和作者效应都具有稳健性。侦探小说和冒险小说的集中度低于其时代平均水平的小说。文学史将罗马- feuilleton解读为超级英雄的小说或不断增殖情节的形式，而根据这一结构指标，我们的结果支持第二种解读。在 feuilleton时代（1840-1914年），那些其职业生涯由报纸连载结构的人物的作者，在扣除时代、体裁和经典因素后，比文学对照组更均匀地分配中心性。由于这些主张的可信度仅取决于它们所依赖的网络，我们还评估了提取流程在人物和人物身份层面与人工标注小说的一致性。

articles.title: Attention Temperature Confounds Zero-Shot Context Extension
articles.abstract: A training-time attention change is usually judged for zero-shot context extension against a dense baseline beyond the training length at the default temperature, $τ= 1$. The outcome depends on how miscalibrated the baseline is there: the share of perplexity it recovers when its logits are sharpened by one scalar. Under the standard recipe (fp32 master weights), an 8k-trained baseline is 8-15% miscalibrated at 30k in three seed-paired 365M twins; in one of them this makes the block-sparse-trained twin look 7% better, which calibration removes. In pure-bf16 training without master weights the miscalibration is several times larger: an AdamW step ($β_2 = 0.95$) on a gain initialised at 1.0 is below half the bf16 spacing at peak learning rates under $1.7\times10^{-3}$, so gains never move (22 checkpoints), the baseline is 37-58% miscalibrated, and block-sparse pretraining, attention dropout and ALiBi look 6-35% better. Calibrating one temperature per model and length removes all three advantages, leaves ALiBi 5% behind RoPE and keeps part of the gain of a positive control, NTK-aware scaling. Unfreezing the gains reverses the block-sparse advantage at 365M and removes 71-89% of it at 1.2B. We recommend reporting extension results at calibrated temperatures and checking that normalisation gains moved.
articles.titleCn: 注意力温度混淆零样本上下文扩展
articles.abstractCn: 训练时注意力变化通常用于评估在默认温度 $τ= 1$ 下，超出训练长度的密集基线上的零样本上下文扩展。结果取决于基线在此处的校准误差程度：当其logits通过一个标量锐化时，它能恢复的困惑度比例。在标准配方（fp32主权重）下，一个训练了8k的基线在30k时，在三组种子配对的365M双胞胎中存在8-15%的校准误差；其中一组使块稀疏训练的双胞胎看起来好7%，这种校准误差被消除。在纯bf16训练且无主权重的情况下，校准误差更大：一个AdamW步骤（$β_2 = 0.95$）在初始增益为1.0的情况下，在峰值学习率 $1.7\times10^{-3}$ 时低于bf16间隔的一半，因此增益从未移动（22个检查点），基线校准误差为37-58%，块稀疏预训练、注意力dropout和ALiBi看起来好6-35%。校准每个模型和长度的温度消除了所有三种优势，使ALiBi落后于RoPE 5%，并保留了部分正向控制NTK感知缩放的增益。解冻增益会逆转365M时的块稀疏优势，并在1.2B时消除71-89%的优势。我们建议在校准温度下报告扩展结果，并检查归一化增益是否移动。

articles.title: Look Back, Draft Ahead: Corrective Prefix Attention for Parallel Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: Parallel speculative decoders propose an entire token block at once, yet one early inconsistency can cause the target to reject its remaining suffix. We introduce Corrective Prefix Attention (CPA), which combines prefix-aware selection with autoregressive supervision to improve these parallel drafts. CPA lets each candidate attend to earlier choices within the block. Fixed candidate shortlists allow all pairwise interactions to be computed before selection, reducing the sequential walk to table lookups, accumulation and lightweight scoring rather than repeated neural evaluations. An auxiliary autoregressive loss trains the shared backbone on clean prefixes without adding an inference pass. Across eight math, code and dialogue benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B targets on Ascend NPUs, CPA commits 13--15\% more tokens per verification round than DSpark and 25--26\% more than DFlash. Its mean speedups reach $3.35\times$ and $3.37\times$ under greedy decoding and $2.86\times$ under sampling for both targets. Ablations support both components, while capacity sweeps demonstrate that greater acceptance alone does not guarantee faster decoding. These results motivate correcting parallel proposals with causal information while keeping sequential computation inexpensive.
articles.titleCn: 回顾向前，草稿先行：并行推测解码的纠正前缀注意力
articles.abstractCn: 并行投机解码器一次性提出整个标记块，但一个早期的不一致性可能导致目标拒绝其剩余的后缀。我们引入了纠正前缀注意力（CPA），它结合了前缀感知选择和自回归监督来改进这些并行草案。CPA允许每个候选关注块内的早期选择。固定的候选短名单允许在选择之前计算所有成对交互，将顺序遍历减少为表查找、累积和轻量级评分，而不是重复的神经评估。一个辅助的自回归损失在无需增加推理过程的情况下训练共享骨干网络于干净的标记前缀。在Ascend NPU上针对Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B目标的八个数学、代码和对话基准测试中，CPA在验证轮次中每验证的标记数比DSpark多13--15%，比DFlash多25--26%。其平均加速比在贪婪解码下达到3.35倍和3.37倍，在采样下达到2.86倍。消融实验支持这两个组件，而容量扫描表明仅提高接受率并不能保证更快的解码。这些结果激励我们在保持顺序计算低成本的同时，用因果信息纠正并行提案。

articles.title: Unlocking the Power of Loops in Pretrained LLMs with Loop Residuals
articles.abstract: Looped Transformers iterate a shared block of layers to increase computation without adding parameters, offering stronger performance and test-time scaling. However, this power has so far required training from scratch and yielded only modest gains for LLMs. Finetuning existing models into loops is far cheaper, yet also brings only marginal gains over SFT. We propose LoopRes, an effective, scalable, and simple approach that turns loops into significant and consistent gains for pretrained LLMs. Building on Attention Residuals, LoopRes lets each looped layer attend directly to the outputs of earlier loops. Since these outputs are iterates of the same layers and become harder to tell apart, we give each a trainable loop-aware key that encodes its structural identity. Attending to all earlier loops also lets layers skip intermediate ones, so we restrict each layer to a residual window of the latest W loops, forcing every loop to build incrementally on recent ones. Across 6 pretrained LLMs from 3 model families and 9 benchmarks, LoopRes delivers significant and consistent gains: at 2x compute, it improves Qwen3-1.7B-Base by 29.1% over SFT, more than doubling the gain of the state-of-the-art baseline. The gains hold on larger models up to 30B and across all three families. More importantly, from 1.7B to 8B, LoopRes scales more steeply than SFT as compute grows, reaching a higher ceiling while needing less compute on long outputs. These results establish LoopRes as an effective looping approach, delivering both better performance and better test-time scaling.
articles.titleCn: 利用循环残差解锁预训练LLM的潜力
articles.abstractCn: 循环Transformer通过迭代共享的层块来增加计算量而不增加参数，从而提供更强的性能和测试时扩展性。然而，这种能力至今需要从头开始训练，并且仅对大型语言模型（LLMs）带来了适度的提升。将现有模型微调成循环结构成本更低，但相对于监督微调（SFT）也仅带来了微小的增益。我们提出了LoopRes，这是一种有效、可扩展且简单的方法，将循环转化为对预训练LLMs的显著且一致的增益。基于注意力残差，LoopRes允许每个循环层直接关注早期循环的输出。由于这些输出是相同层的迭代，并且越来越难以区分，我们为每个输出分配一个可训练的循环感知键，以编码其结构身份。关注所有早期循环还允许层跳过中间层，因此我们将每个层限制在最新W个循环的残差窗口内，迫使每个循环在最近的循环基础上逐步构建。在3个模型家族的6个预训练LLMs和9个基准测试中，LoopRes带来了显著且一致的增益：在计算量翻倍的情况下，它使Qwen3-1.7B-Base相对于SFT提升了29.1%，超过了当前最佳基线的增益的两倍多。这些增益在更大的模型（高达30B）和所有三个家族中都成立。更重要的是，从1.7B到8B，随着计算量的增加，LoopRes的扩展性比SFT更陡峭，在长输出上需要更少的计算量即可达到更高的上限。这些结果确立了LoopRes作为一种有效的循环方法，既能提供更好的性能，也能实现更好的测试时扩展性。

articles.title: UMAMI: A Multimodal Benchmark Dataset for Evidence-Grounded Dietary Decisions
articles.abstract: Dietary decisions require identifying a food's nutrient content and considering individual dietary needs, but recognizing food from an image alone does not provide this information. Visually similar foods can have different nutrient profiles, so selecting the wrong food record can lead to incorrect decisions even when nutrient rules are applied correctly. Furthermore, satisfying nutrient constraints does not necessarily establish a food's relevance to a person's intake. Evaluating these challenges together requires connecting food images, nutrient records, and individual intake histories. To support this evaluation, we introduce UMAMI (Unified Multimodal Assessment of Meals and Intake), a multimodal dataset and benchmark linking independently collected food images with nutrient profiles and respondent health and intake records. Using this dataset, we construct three diagnostic tasks covering visual nutrient question answering, personalized food recommendation, and condition-aware food substitution. Paired instances and input controls examine how visual identity and respondent context affect decisions. Our experiments identify errors in both food-record selection and nutrient-rule application, while showing that higher rule compliance does not necessarily improve alignment with subsequent recorded intake. These findings highlight the need to evaluate how multimodal systems select and use structured evidence for dietary decisions. The dataset, code, and dashboard are available at https://umami-benchmark.github.io.
articles.comment: 40 pages, 15 figures, 16 tables. Dataset, code, and dashboard: https://umami-benchmark.github.io
articles.titleCn: 鲜味：用于证据支持饮食决策的多模态基准数据集
articles.abstractCn: 膳食决策需要识别食物的营养成分并考虑个体膳食需求，但仅凭图像识别食物无法提供这些信息。视觉相似的食物可能具有不同的营养特征，因此选择错误的食物记录即使营养规则应用正确也可能导致错误决策。此外，满足营养约束并不必然确立食物与个人摄入的相关性。综合评估这些挑战需要将食物图像、营养记录和个体摄入历史联系起来。为此，我们引入UMAMI（统一膳食与摄入多模态评估），这是一个多模态数据集和基准，将独立收集的食物图像与营养特征以及受访者健康和摄入记录相链接。利用该数据集，我们构建了三个诊断任务，涵盖视觉营养问答、个性化食物推荐和条件感知食物替代。配对实例和输入控制检验了视觉身份和受访者背景如何影响决策。我们的实验识别了食物记录选择和营养规则应用中的错误，同时表明更高的规则合规性并不必然改善与后续记录摄入的匹配度。这些发现突出了评估多模态系统如何为膳食决策选择和使用结构化证据的必要性。数据集、代码和仪表板可在https://umami-benchmark.github.io获取。

articles.title: DKnown-Jev-2: Article-Level Answer-Evidence Classification and Efficient Inference with a Pre-trained Language Model
articles.abstract: Evidence selection in normative knowledge question answering requires determining whether a candidate article contains content that directly supports an answer under the applicable conditions of the question. We present DKnown-Jev-2, an article-level answer evidence classifier designed for evidence integration across multiple paragraphs. The model jointly encodes question conditions, article metadata, and paragraph content, and uses a pointer-style classification head to predict Answer Evidence (AE) and Non-answer Evidence (NE) in a single forward pass. Ona manually annotated test set of 972 evaluation instances, DKnown-Jev-2 achieves 91.77% accuracy and 91.28% macro-F1, outperforming Jev by 2.16 and 2.37 percentage points, respectively, while reducing both evidence misses and non-evidence false positives. The test set contains 317 multi-paragraph instances, with a maximum body length of 9,322 characters. Shared article encoding and non-autoregressive classification support low-latency inference. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method for article-level evidence selection in normative knowledge question answering.
articles.titleCn: DKnown-Jev-2：基于预训练语言模型的论文级答案-证据分类与高效推理
articles.abstractCn: 规范知识问答中的证据选择需要判断候选文章是否在适用条件下包含直接支持答案的内容。我们提出了DKnown-Jev-2，这是一种用于跨多段落的文章级答案证据分类器。该模型联合编码问题条件、文章元数据和段落内容，并使用指针式分类头在单次前向传递中预测答案证据（AE）和非答案证据（NE）。在包含972个评估实例的手动标注测试集上，DKnown-Jev-2实现了91.77%的准确率和91.28%的宏观F1值，分别比Jev高出2.16和2.37个百分点，同时减少了证据遗漏和非证据误报。测试集中包含317个多段落实例，最大正文长度为9,322个字符。共享文章编码和非自回归分类支持低延迟推理。这些结果表明，所提出的方法在规范知识问答的文章级证据选择中是有效的。

articles.title: CAST: A Deployed Speech-to-Text Cascade for Closed Captioning of Entertainment Television
articles.abstract: Despite rapid progress in automatic speech recognition (ASR), caption generation for long-form entertainment video remains challenging for content dense in music and effects, rich in accents, crosstalk, and noise. The transcript quality depends on segmentation and surrounding modules as much as the acoustic model. A single pass voice activity detection (VAD) can miss faint, low-energy voice while forwarding near-silent segments that induce hallucination and repetition in an autoregressive decoder. These competing errors motivate a hierarchical VAD that revisits rejected segments under semantic and acoustic retention checks. We present Captioning ASR Stack for Television (CAST), an integrated speech-to-text pipeline for closed captioning (CC) combining frozen Whisper large-v3 with segmentation, language identification, lyrics routing, and targeted hallucination detection and repair on a single NVIDIA L4 GPU. On 100 in-house assets spanning 60.46 hours, CAST reduces normalized WER from 6.99% to 5.36% and subtitle edit rate from 254.2 to 221.9 min/hour against the WhisperX pipeline, and improves deletion rate by 11% on public datasets. We also present the behavior of each stage in the pipeline. CAST entered the production speech-to-text (STT) stage of our CC pipeline in late August 2026; we report the evaluation evidence and path to full-scale operation.
articles.comment: Accepted at AAAI-27, Innovative Applications of AI (IAAI) track, poster. Aditya Mishra and Thanish Bolla are co-first authors. 10 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables
articles.titleCn: 角色：一个用于娱乐电视字幕的部署式语音转文本级联系统
articles.abstractCn: 尽管自动语音识别（ASR）取得了快速进展，但针对音乐和音效密集、口音丰富、多人对话和噪声干扰严重的长视频娱乐内容进行字幕生成仍具挑战性。转录质量不仅取决于声学模型，还与分段和周边模块密切相关。单次语音活动检测（VAD）可能会遗漏微弱、低能量的语音，同时将近乎静音的片段传递给自回归解码器，从而引发幻觉和重复错误。这些竞争性错误促使我们提出分层VAD，该VAD在语义和声学保留检查下重新审视被拒绝的片段。我们提出了电视字幕生成ASR堆栈（CAST），这是一个集成式语音转文本管道，用于闭路字幕（CC），结合了冻结的Whisper large-v3模型，以及分段、语言识别、歌词路由，并在单个NVIDIA L4 GPU上进行目标幻觉检测和修复。在涵盖60.46小时100个内部资产上，CAST将归一化WER从6.99%降低到5.36%，将字幕编辑率从254.2降至221.9分钟/小时，并在公共数据集上提高了11%的删除率。我们还展示了管道中每个阶段的行为。CAST于2026年8月下旬进入我们闭路字幕管道的生产语音转文本（STT）阶段；我们报告了评估证据和全面运营的路径。

articles.title: Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning
articles.abstract: Spatial reasoning across multiple views requires inferring the 3D relations between objects and the camera from 2D observations, which depends on cross-view correspondence and scene geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) do not reliably extract. Pretrained vision encoders already capture this information in their latent features, with CLIP linking objects to image regions, DINOv3 matching semantics across views, and VGGT encoding multi-view geometry. However, VLMs do not benefit from these features when we present them directly in context as grayscale feature images. We therefore propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that parses latent features into explicit spatial evidence for VLMs. In LatentParse, an analyst VLM probes the features of all three encoders with predefined tools that locate objects, track them across views, and measure motion between views. It then distills the results into a concise text report, which is provided together with the images to the VLM to answer the question. We evaluate LatentParse on MMSI-Bench, MV-RoboBench and SPAR-Bench, where it improves all five VLMs over the photo-only baseline by 0.7-2.4 percentage points on average. On MMSI-Bench, it raises Qwen3.8-27B from 34.4% to 39.5%, with the largest improvements of 19.2 percentage points on the camera-related questions. These results suggest that latent features become useful for spatial reasoning once they are parsed into relation evidence, without training. Code is available at https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse.
articles.titleCn: 解析用于多模态空间推理的视觉潜空间
articles.abstractCn: 跨视图的空间推理需要从二维观测中推断物体与相机之间的三维关系，这依赖于跨视图对应关系和场景几何信息，而视觉语言模型（VLMs）无法可靠地提取这些信息。预训练的视觉编码器已经在其潜在特征中捕获了这些信息，其中CLIP将物体链接到图像区域，DINOv3跨视图匹配语义，VGGT编码多视图几何。然而，当我们直接以灰度特征图像的形式将它们呈现给VLMs时，VLMs无法从中受益。因此，我们提出了LatentParse，这是一个无需训练的框架，用于将潜在特征解析为VLMs的显式空间证据。在LatentParse中，一个分析型VLM使用预定义的工具探测所有三个编码器的特征，这些工具可以定位物体、跨视图追踪物体以及测量视图间的运动。然后，它将结果提炼成一个简洁的文本报告，该报告连同图像一起提供给VLM以回答问题。我们在MMSI-Bench、MV-RoboBench和SPAR-Bench上评估了LatentParse，平均而言，它在照片基线的基础上将所有五个VLMs提升了0.7-2.4个百分点。在MMSI-Bench上，它将Qwen3.8-27B从34.4%提升到39.5%，在相机相关问题上的最大提升达到了19.2个百分点。这些结果表明，一旦潜在特征被解析为关系证据，它们就变得对空间推理有用，而无需训练。代码可在https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse获取。

articles.title: Can Latent Reasoning Drive LLM Outputs Without a Trace?
articles.abstract: LLMs typically solve complex tasks with chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, which is also the main tool for monitoring them for misaligned behavior. However, standard transformers can also solve tasks with complete latent reasoning (CLR), carrying out the whole task internally and outputting only the final answer. Theory bounds the depth of CLR, the number of sequential steps it can carry out, and recent work measured it to be shallow. In this work, we ask whether CLR is deep enough for a model to pursue a hidden objective that requires reasoning. Such a model would generate a CoT that appears to solve the given task, while a latent multi-step computation decides its answer based on the hidden objective. First, we show that a simple auxiliary loss allows models to solve a multi-step task latently at least 5x deeper than previously reported. Then, in two common tasks, decision-making and code generation, we train a model to pursue such a hidden objective, which decides a loan or plants a vulnerability. The model's CoT justifies the output with no trace of the hidden objective, and a strong LLM monitor does not flag it. Finally, using activation patching, we find that the latent computation is completed before the model generates its CoT, which takes no part in it. Altogether, we show that a hidden objective that requires reasoning can go unseen by a monitor that reads only the output.
articles.titleCn: 潜逻辑推理能否在不留痕迹的情况下驱动大型语言模型的输出？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型通常通过思维链（CoT）推理来解决复杂任务，这也是监控它们是否存在行为偏差的主要工具。然而，标准Transformer也能通过完整潜在推理（CLR）完成任务，将整个任务在内部完成，仅输出最终答案。理论界界定了CLR的深度、其可执行的顺序步骤数量，而近期研究测量其深度较浅。在本工作中，我们探究CLR是否足够深，以至于模型能够追求需要推理的隐藏目标。此类模型会生成看似能解决给定任务的CoT，而潜在的多步计算则根据隐藏目标决定其答案。首先，我们证明一个简单的辅助损失允许模型至少以比先前报告深5倍的深度进行潜在的多步任务求解。接着，在决策和代码生成这两个常见任务中，我们训练一个模型去追求这样的隐藏目标，该目标决定是否发放贷款或植入漏洞。该模型的CoT以无隐藏目标痕迹的方式为其输出辩护，而强大的LLM监控器也无法将其标记。最后，通过激活修补技术，我们发现潜在计算在模型生成CoT之前已完成，而CoT并未参与其中。总而言之，我们证明了一个需要推理的隐藏目标，在仅读取输出的监控器看来是难以被察觉的。

articles.title: RoboUniverse-10K: Toward the Scaling Era of Agentic Robotics via Real-to-Sim Environments
articles.abstract: Agentic Robotics, in which foundation models act as coding agents to control robots through executable programs, has emerged as a compelling paradigm for embodied intelligence. Yet unlike software engineering, where massive executable environments power post-training, robotics remains constrained by small, manual benchmarks and in-distribution evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce RoboUniverse-10K, 10,807 interactive, resettable, and verifiable physics environments built from real-world videos via an automated Real2Sim and quality assurance pipeline. Each runs in an isolated, Harbor-compatible harness that hides privileged states and grading logic to mirror real-world sensing. From the same pipeline, we hold out 500 unseen tasks to establish RoboUniverse-Verified, an expert-verified zero-shot benchmark. Evaluating 11 closed- and open-source models reveals a huge gap: frontier models reach 85.8\% success, while open-source baselines lag at 2.6\% to 10.0\%, bottlenecked by low-level grasping, deformable-object manipulation, and post-contact physical control. Finally, we collect about 17K multi-turn trajectories totaling 0.79B tokens with GPT-6 Astra and perform full-parameter supervised fine-tuning on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, yielding RoboUniverse-35B-A3B. Our model achieves substantial zero-shot gains on RoboUniverse-Verified, lifting the success rate from 0.8\% to 21.2\%, while achieving zero-shot task completions across LIBERO-MAX, RoboCasa, RoboTwin 2.0, and a real Franka arm. We open-source the RL-ready environments and model to lay the foundation for large-scale reinforcement learning in Agentic Robotics.
articles.titleCn: RoboUniverse-10K：迈向自主机器人规模化时代的真实到模拟环境
articles.abstractCn: 自主机器人学，其中基础模型作为编码代理通过可执行程序控制机器人，已成为具身智能的一种引人入胜的范式。然而与软件工程不同，后者依靠大规模可执行环境在训练后提供支持，机器人学仍然受限于小型手动基准和分布内评估。为弥合这一差距，我们引入了RoboUniverse-10K，这是一个包含10,807个交互式、可重置和可验证的物理环境，这些环境通过自动化的Real2Sim和质量保证流程从真实世界视频构建而成。每个环境都在一个隔离的、兼容Harbor的框架中运行，该框架隐藏了特权状态和评分逻辑，以模拟现实世界的感知。从同一流程中，我们保留了500个未见过的任务，以建立RoboUniverse-Verified，这是一个专家验证的零样本基准。评估11个闭源和开源模型揭示了巨大差距：前沿模型达到85.8%的成功率，而开源基线则落后于2.6%到10.0%，受限于低级抓取、可变形物体操作和接触后物理控制。最后，我们使用GPT-6 Astra收集了约17K个多轮轨迹，总计0.79B个token，并在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B上进行了全参数监督微调，生成了RoboUniverse-35B-A3B。我们的模型在RoboUniverse-Verified上实现了显著的零样本增益，将成功率从0.8%提升到21.2%，同时在LIBERO-MAX、RoboCasa、RoboTwin 2.0和一个真实Franka手臂上实现了零样本任务完成。我们开源了RL就绪的环境和模型，为自主机器人学中的大规模强化学习奠定基础。

articles.title: CART: Clustering-based Analysis of Recurring narratives for Taxonomy construction
articles.abstract: We present CART, a computational pipeline for extracting political narratives from parliamentary discourse and organizing them into a data-driven taxonomy without relying on predefined narrative categories. It encodes parliamentary discourse using semantic representations, filters relevant and reliable content through unsupervised confidence estimation, extracts narrative statements using LLMs, and uses narrative clustering and cluster analysis to construct a narrative taxonomy. Applied to Greek Parliament proceedings surrounding the 2023 Tempi train crash, it identifies ten recurring narrative families concerning responsibility attribution, institutional failure, railway safety, accountability, privatization, and the political interpretation of the tragedy. Our results demonstrate how combining unsupervised learning with LLM narrative extraction enables large parliamentary corpora to be transformed into interpretable, data-driven taxonomies of political narratives.
articles.titleCn: 基于聚类的循环叙事分析以构建分类体系：CART
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了CART，一个用于从议会辩论中提取政治叙事并将其组织成数据驱动分类体系的计算流程，该流程无需依赖预定义的叙事类别。它通过语义表示编码议会辩论内容，通过无监督置信度估计过滤相关且可靠的内容，利用大型语言模型提取叙事性陈述，并采用叙事聚类和聚类分析构建叙事分类体系。应用于2023年希腊Tempi火车事故相关的希腊议会辩论记录，它识别出十个关于责任归属、制度失败、铁路安全、问责制、私有化和悲剧的政治解读等反复出现的叙事家族。我们的结果表明，结合无监督学习与大型语言模型叙事提取，能够将大规模议会语料库转化为可解释、数据驱动的政治叙事分类体系。

articles.title: Beyond Self-Consistency: Recursive Self-Improvement at Test Time
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) that continue improving after deployment (e.g., recursive self-improvement) offer a promising path toward general intelligence. Current test-time methods pursue this goal on unlabeled questions, primarily relying on self-consistency: they generate independent solutions and use majority voting to select an answer or construct training targets. This leaves earlier reasoning unused at inference and can reinforce an incorrect majority during training. Humans instead build on earlier attempts to preserve useful reasoning, correct mistakes and improve their problem-solving strategies. Following this principle, we propose Test-Time Recursive Self-Improvement (TT-RSI), a label-free framework for improving LLMs at test time through two mutually reinforcing components: (1) In-Context RSI repeatedly re-solves each question using the full previous solution as a reference, letting the model decide whether and how to use it so that inference compute builds on earlier reasoning. (2) In-Weight RSI distills successive refinements into the model's weights, enabling progress beyond an initially wrong majority and theoretically bringing the first attempt toward the model's infinite-step refinement limit. The updated model answers better and refines more effectively, generating stronger references for subsequent training. Extensive experiments show that TT-RSI improves average accuracy by +13.89% over the base model and outperforms the strongest self-consistency-based method by +4.79% under the same test-time scaling budget.
articles.titleCn: 超越自洽性：测试时的递归自我改进
articles.abstractCn: 在部署后持续改进的大型语言模型（LLM）（例如，递归自我改进）为通用智能提供了一条有前景的路径。当前的测试时方法主要依靠自洽性，在未标记的问题上追求这一目标：它们生成独立的解决方案，并使用多数投票来选择答案或构建训练目标。这导致推理时未使用早期的推理，并在训练过程中可能强化错误的多数。相反，人类基于早期的尝试来保留有用的推理、纠正错误并改进他们的问题解决策略。遵循这一原则，我们提出了测试时递归自我改进（TT-RSI），这是一个无标签框架，通过两个相互强化的组件在测试时改进LLM：（1）上下文递归自我改进（In-Context RSI）反复使用完整的先前解决方案作为参考来重新解决每个问题，让模型决定是否以及如何使用它，从而让推理计算建立在早期的推理之上。（2）权重递归自我改进（In-Weight RSI）将连续的改进蒸馏到模型的权重中，使模型能够超越最初错误的多数，理论上将首次尝试推向模型的无限步改进极限。更新后的模型回答得更好，改进得更有效，为后续训练生成更强的参考。大量实验表明，TT-RSI比基础模型平均准确率提高了+13.89%，在相同的测试时扩展预算下，比最强的基于自洽性的方法提高了+4.79%。

articles.title: LimeTree: Linear-Memory Graph Neural Networks over Tree-Graphs for Resource-Efficient Language Modeling and Context Extrapolation
articles.abstract: The search for computationally efficient alternatives to the Transformer has yielded numerous architectures in recent years; however, most exhibit severe weaknesses in associative recall-such as key-value (KV) retrieval-and length extrapolation, where even standard Transformers struggle. This paper introduces LimeTree, a linear-complexity architecture in both memory and compute for sequence modeling. By integrating synthetic KV retrieval tasks directly into standard language modeling training, LimeTree achieves strong perplexity alongside reliable recall. Two variants were evaluated on WikiText-103 and PG-19 under strict compute constraints. On WikiText-103, LimeTree reaches a token-level perplexity of 19 in just 6 hours on four Quadro RTX 8000 GPUs, while maintaining 100\% KV retrieval accuracy even when extrapolating from a training context length of 512 to an evaluation length of 16,384. On PG-19, the model achieves a token-level perplexity of 13 in 35 hours on a single RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU with minimal hyperparameter tuning. These results position LimeTree as a competitive linear-complexity alternative to Transformers, combining superior perplexity and training throughput with robust in-context retrieval and length extrapolation.
articles.titleCn: LimeTree：基于树形图的线性内存图神经网络，用于资源高效的语言建模和上下文外推
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，为Transformer寻找计算效率更高的替代方案已催生出众多架构；然而，大多数架构在关联回忆（如键值检索）和长度外推方面存在严重缺陷，即使是标准的Transformer也难以克服。本文介绍了LimeTree，这是一种在内存和计算复杂度上均为线性的序列建模架构。通过将合成键值检索任务直接整合到标准语言模型训练中，LimeTree在实现可靠回忆的同时达到了优异的困惑度。在严格的计算约束下，LimeTree的两个变体在WikiText-103和PG-19数据集上进行了评估。在WikiText-103上，LimeTree仅用6小时在四块Quadro RTX 8000 GPU上就达到了19的token级困惑度，同时即使从512的训练上下文长度外推到16,384的评估长度，仍能保持100%的键值检索准确率。在PG-19上，该模型通过少量超参数调整，在单块RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU上35小时后达到了13的token级困惑度。这些结果将LimeTree定位为Transformer的竞争性线性复杂度替代方案，它结合了优越的困惑度、训练吞吐量、稳健的上下文检索和长度外推能力。

articles.title: PRIMEAPE: A Multilingual Benchmark for Fine-Grained Meta-Evaluation of Judge Models
articles.abstract: Large language models increasingly serve as judges of other models, shaping benchmark rankings and model development. Yet, a judge whose rationale consistently supports its verdict may still disagree with human preferences. To study this, we introduce PRIMEAPE, a multilingual benchmark for evaluating judge verdicts and rationales. PRIMEAPE provides 2,205 response pairs covering 243 instructions in English, French, Spanish, Urdu, Hindi, Norwegian Bokmål, and Yoruba, with 11k human annotations of preferences and rationales across relevance, naturalness, truthfulness, safety, and overall quality. Our evaluation of twelve open- and closed-weight judges reveals that aggregate performance conceals differences across languages and criteria, while requesting rationales does not consistently improve agreement with human preferences. Judges also favor the first position, longer responses, and responses from related models, with effects that vary across criteria and languages. Crucially, judges can justify verdicts that disagree with human preferences while maintaining consistency between their verdicts and rationales. These findings show that consistency with a judge's own verdict does not establish alignment with human judgment. PRIMEAPE enables assessment of both, providing a foundation for more reliable multilingual judges. We release our benchmark and all annotation materials under the CC BY-NC 4.0 license at github.com/Toloka/primeape.
articles.titleCn: PRIMEAPE：一种用于细粒度元评估法官模型的多元语言基准
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型越来越多地充当其他模型的评判者，塑造基准排名和模型开发。然而，一个其推理始终支持其裁决的评判者仍可能与人类偏好不一致。为研究这一问题，我们引入了PRIMEAPE，一个用于评估评判者裁决和推理的多语言基准。PRIMEAPE提供了涵盖英语、法语、西班牙语、乌尔都语、印地语、挪威博克马尔语和约鲁巴语共243条指令的2205对响应，包含11k条关于相关性、自然性、真实性、安全性及整体质量的偏好和推理的人类标注。我们对十二个开放权重和封闭权重的评判者进行的评估表明，综合性能掩盖了不同语言和标准间的差异，而要求提供推理并不总能持续提高与人类偏好的符合度。评判者还倾向于首选项、较长的响应以及来自相关模型的响应，这些效应在不同标准和语言间存在差异。关键在于，评判者可以为其与人类偏好不一致的裁决提供理由，同时保持其裁决与推理之间的一致性。这些发现表明，与评判者自身裁决的一致性并不能建立与人类判断的符合度。PRIMEAPE能够评估这两者，为更可靠的多语言评判者奠定了基础。我们在github.com/Toloka/primeape上以CC BY-NC 4.0许可协议发布了我们的基准和所有标注材料。

articles.title: Semantic-aware Decoding for Diverse Text-to-SQL under Schema Ambiguity
articles.abstract: Real-world text-to-SQL systems often face schema ambiguity, where a question can map to multiple plausible schema elements. To support downstream disambiguation, SQL generation systems should include diverse interpretations among their top-k predictions. However, large language models (LLMs) typically favor a single interpretation, producing highly skewed outputs. We propose Semantic-aware Logit Adjustment (SLA), a training-free decoding method that promotes diverse SQL generation by adjusting token logits based on semantic similarity between schema elements. Unlike prior approaches that rely on reasoning-intensive prompting or task-specific fine-tuning, SLA is efficient, model-agnostic, and easy to deploy. Experiments show that SLA consistently improves interpretation coverage over standard decoding and remains competitive with existing diversity-oriented methods at substantially lower inference cost.
articles.titleCn: 在模式模糊性下的多样化文本到SQL语义感知解码
articles.abstractCn: 现实中的文本到SQL系统常常面临模式模糊问题，即一个问题可能对应多个合理的模式元素。为了支持下游的消歧，SQL生成系统应在其top-k预测中包含多样化的解释。然而，大型语言模型（LLMs）通常倾向于单一解释，产生高度倾斜的输出。我们提出了语义感知逻辑调整（SLA），这是一种无需训练的解码方法，通过根据模式元素之间的语义相似性调整token逻辑概率来促进多样化的SQL生成。与依赖推理密集型提示或特定任务微调的先前方法不同，SLA高效、模型无关且易于部署。实验表明，SLA始终在标准解码上提高了解释覆盖率，并在显著更低的推理成本下与现有的多样性导向方法保持竞争力。

articles.title: SARA: An Auditor-in-the-Loop LLM Recommender for Sustainability Reports
articles.abstract: Auditing corporate sustainability reports requires assurance professionals to map a company-specific checklist drawn from roughly 1,700 regulatory requirements onto the relevant passages of lengthy, repeatedly revised draft reports and to judge compliance. We present SARA (Sustainability Reporting Assistant), a human-in-the-loop recommender system delivered as a Microsoft Word add-in that recommends, for each requirement, the passages addressing it and predicts a compliance verdict while keeping the auditor in full control. SARA casts auditing as content-based recommendation over a fixed regulatory taxonomy and makes per-requirement large language model (LLM) matching cheaper, faster, and more accurate through topic-prediction filtering: on expert-annotated reports, it reduces matching cost about sixfold and runtime by 42% versus feeding the full report to the LLM. It is in production use across PwC Germany's sustainability-assurance practice.
articles.comment: Accepted at IEEE BigData 2026 as poster paper. 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 table
articles.titleCn: SARA：一种用于可持续发展报告的循环审计员LLM推荐系统
articles.abstractCn: 审计企业可持续发展报告需要保证员将源自约1,700项监管要求的、特定于公司的清单映射到冗长且反复修订的草拟报告的相关段落，并判断其合规性。我们提出了SARA（可持续发展报告助手），这是一个人类参与式推荐系统，作为Microsoft Word插件提供，它为每项要求推荐处理该要求的段落，并预测合规性结论，同时让审计员完全掌控。SARA将审计视为基于内容的推荐，通过主题预测过滤，使每项要求的语言模型（LLM）匹配更加经济、快速和准确：在专家标注的报告中，与将完整报告输入LLM相比，它将匹配成本降低了约六倍，并将运行时间缩短了42%。该系统已在PwC德国的可持续发展保证实践中投入使用。

articles.title: Task-Dependent Linguistic Measures in Aphasia Discourse: A Comparative Analysis of Narrative, Descriptive, and Procedural Speech
articles.abstract: Background: Transcript-based measures such as word counts, lexical diversity and disfluency rates are widely used to describe language ability in aphasia. Each measure comes from a specific elicitation task, and studies use different tasks, so values from different tasks may not be comparable. Aims: To test whether discourse tasks change these measures within the same speakers, and whether the measures follow a gradient from Procedural to Descriptive to Narrative discourse. Methods & Procedures: Baseline transcripts from 61 adults with chronic post-stroke aphasia were taken from the Fridriksson-2 corpus in AphasiaBank (POLAR trial, ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03416738). Each speaker produced a Procedural (Sandwich), a Descriptive (Broken Window) and a Narrative (Cinderella) sample in one session. A rule-based pipeline extracted 13 measures, 10 of which were common enough to test. Friedman, Page and Wilcoxon tests with false discovery rate correction were used, with a speaker-grouped Random Forest classifier as a supporting check. Outcomes & Results: Total words and number of different words followed the full gradient, but the step from Procedural to Descriptive was small. For most other measures, Narrative stood apart, while Descriptive and Procedural did not differ. Among the 31 speakers with at least 25 words in every task, filler rate, repetition rate and total disfluency density were higher in Narrative than in both other tasks. The classifier reached an accuracy of 0.61 (always guessing the most common task would give 0.41), mainly by recognizing Narrative samples. Conclusions: Discourse tasks are not interchangeable, and expressing disfluencies per word does not remove the task effect. The task should be reported with every measure, and values should be compared only within the same task.
articles.titleCn: 失语症话语中的任务相关语言指标：叙事、描述和程序性言语的比较分析
articles.abstractCn: 背景：基于文本的指标，如词数、词汇多样性和流畅度比率，被广泛用于描述失语症患者的语言能力。每个指标都来自特定的诱导任务，而研究使用不同的任务，因此不同任务的结果可能不可比。目的：检验话语任务是否会在同一说话者内部改变这些指标，以及这些指标是否从程序性话语到描述性话语再到叙事性话语呈现梯度变化。方法与程序：从AphasiaBank（POLAR试验，ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03416738）中的Fridriksson-2语料库中选取了61名慢性中风后失语症成年人的基线文本。每位说话者在一次会话中产出程序性（三明治）、描述性（破损的窗户）和叙事性（灰姑娘）样本各一个。基于规则的管道提取了13个指标，其中10个足够进行检验。使用Friedman、Page和Wilcoxon检验，并进行了假发现率校正，同时以说话者分组的随机森林分类器作为辅助检验。结果与结论：总词数和不同词数量呈现完整梯度，但程序性到描述性的变化很小。对于大多数其他指标，叙事性明显突出，而描述性和程序性之间没有差异。在31名每个任务至少有25个词的说话者中，填充率、重复率和总流畅度密度在叙事性任务中高于其他两个任务。分类器的准确率达到0.61（总是猜测最常见的任务会给出0.41），主要通过识别叙事性样本实现。结论：话语任务不能互换，每词表达的流畅度并不能消除任务效应。每个指标都应报告任务信息，且数值只能在同一任务内部进行比较。

articles.title: Ask Again: Answer-List Instability in Generative Engines
articles.abstract: Visibility in generative search engines is measured by which entities appear in responses, and in what order. Ask an engine the same question twice and the answer list can change: a different ordering, or different items altogether. Across 60,000 responses, we find that answers to the same prompt name a different first item 32% of the time, and even two answers with the same items disagree on which comes first. The first position is a measurement target of its own. A "clear leader" emerges after seven or eight runs, which are the budgets recommended for brand and source monitoring, but a "close leader" only about half the time. After 25 runs, a close leader is identified only 60% of the time. Variability between engines is larger than within the same engine. For open-ended prompts, the gap is more than double that for determinate ones. Search queries and cited sites observed leave most of the disagreement unexplained. Visibility measurement should report, for each engine, which items appear and how often each comes first, each with its own quantification of uncertainty.
articles.titleCn: 再次询问：生成引擎中答案列表的不稳定性
articles.abstractCn: 在生成式搜索引擎中，可见性是通过哪些实体出现在响应中以及它们的顺序来衡量的。向引擎提出同一个问题两次，答案列表可能会改变：顺序不同，或者完全不同的项目。在60,000个响应中，我们发现针对相同提示的答案，有32%的时间第一个项目不同，甚至两个包含相同项目的答案也会对哪个项目排在首位产生分歧。首位位置本身就是一项独立的衡量指标。经过七到八次运行后，会出现一个“明显的领先者”，这是品牌和来源监测推荐的预算，但“接近的领先者”只有大约一半的时间出现。运行25次后，只有60%的时间能确定“接近的领先者”。不同引擎之间的差异大于同一引擎内部的差异。对于开放式提示，这种差距是确定性提示的两倍多。观察到的搜索查询和引用的网站未能解释大部分分歧。可见性测量应该为每个引擎报告哪些项目出现以及每个项目出现频率的量化不确定性。

articles.title: What Quality Engineers Need to Know About Generative AI: Structured Data Extraction
articles.abstract: In this expository paper, we explain how quality engineers can use large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) for structured data extraction. We introduce the relevant concepts, discuss structured extraction from a measurement-system perspective, and demonstrate its implementation in R and Python. We then present two freely available web-based applications (apps): (a) extracting information from automotive recall notices and (b) monitoring quality engineering research on arXiv. To ensure the accuracy of our AI-driven structured extraction, human evaluators validated the results. In the first app, four reviewers assessed information extracted from 30 recall notices using two models, with 98.6% of the 720 field-level ratings judged fully correct. In the second app, 21 authors evaluated information extracted from 45 of their arXiv papers. All paper summaries were rated mostly correct or correct, although the evaluations identified problems with some classification fields and mathematical expressions. These results demonstrate the practical potential of structured data extraction while emphasizing the need to validate the extracted information. We make both apps and their source code publicly available so that readers can adapt the approach to their own applications.
articles.titleCn: 质量工程师需要了解的生成式人工智能：结构化数据提取
articles.abstractCn: 在这篇说明性论文中，我们阐述了质量工程师如何利用大型语言模型（LLMs）和视觉语言模型（VLMs）进行结构化数据提取。我们介绍了相关概念，从测量系统视角讨论了结构化提取，并在R和Python中展示了其实现方法。随后，我们介绍了两个免费的网络应用程序（a）从汽车召回通知中提取信息，以及（b）监控arXiv上的质量工程研究。为确保AI驱动的结构化提取的准确性，人类评估者对结果进行了验证。在第一个应用程序中，四位评审员使用两种模型评估了30份召回通知中提取的信息，720个字段级评分中有98.6%被判定完全正确。在第二个应用程序中，21位作者评估了从他们45篇arXiv论文中提取的信息。所有论文摘要均被评为大部分正确或正确，尽管评估发现某些分类字段和数学表达式存在问题。这些结果表明了结构化数据提取的实用潜力，同时强调了验证提取信息的重要性。我们公开了这两个应用程序及其源代码，以便读者可以将该方法应用于自己的应用。

articles.title: Trallie: from Free-Form Text to Structured Data with LLMs
articles.abstract: Trallie is an open-source framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to perform information extraction (IE) from natural language sources with or without user guidance. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on extensive labeled datasets or domain-specific training, Trallie enables the conversion of unstructured data into structured formats with minimal or no representative examples. The framework is designed with three key objectives: (i) reducing manual annotation by harnessing prompt-based zero-shot and few-shot capabilities of modern LLMs, (ii) flexibly parsing diverse document formats (i.e., HTML, PDF, TXT, and JSON), and (iii) improving accessibility for non-expert users by automatically inducing schemas from document collections, which can then be refined for extraction. We evaluate Trallie with open-weight LLMs on FDA 510(k) documents and on movie and university websites from SWDE. It outperforms previously reported systems when the target attributes are provided for text extraction and is competitive when it must discover attributes for the schema automatically. The project is available at https://github.com/PiSchool/trallie
articles.titleCn: 特拉利：利用大型语言模型将自由文本转换为结构化数据
articles.abstractCn: Trallie是一个开源框架，它利用大型语言模型（LLMs）在没有或具有用户指导的情况下，从自然语言来源中执行信息提取（IE）。与依赖大量标记数据集或特定领域训练的常规方法不同，Trallie能够将非结构化数据转换为结构化格式，只需最少数量的代表性示例或无需示例。该框架的设计具有三个关键目标：（i）通过利用现代LLMs的基于提示的零样本和少样本能力来减少手动标注，（ii）灵活解析多种文档格式（即HTML、PDF、TXT和JSON），以及（iii）通过自动从文档集合中推导模式来提高非专业用户的可访问性，这些模式可以用于后续的提取并加以完善。我们使用开放权重的LLMs在FDA 510(k)文档以及SWDE中的电影和大学网站上评估了Trallie。当提供目标属性进行文本提取时，它在性能上优于先前报道的系统，并且在需要自动发现模式属性时也具有竞争力。该项目可在https://github.com/PiSchool/trallie获取。

articles.title: CocoonBench: Can Multilingual Search Agents Escape Language Information Cocoons?
articles.abstract: Multilingual search agents can access the global Web, yet may remain trapped in a language environment with insufficient evidence; we refer to this failure as a language information cocoon. However, existing search benchmarks largely operate within a single language, especially English, overlooking entity connections across multiple languages. We introduce CocoonBench, a benchmark that evaluates whether multilingual search agents can escape such language information cocoons. CocoonBench mines answer-centered relational paths from a frozen Wikidata-derived graph and selects clue sets that are individually necessary and jointly identify a unique answer. Using language-specific entity names, it records each task's minimum language cover, removes direct identifiers, and renders each task as matched prompts in three languages together with its construction certificate and provenance. Across 10 state-of-the-art models, mean accuracy on CocoonBench ranges from 33.8% (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) to 69.7% (Claude-Opus-4.8), leaving even the strongest system below 70%. The same construction certificates support path-aligned trajectory analysis, enabling diagnosis of model failures in language routing, evidence-path recovery, and answer use. The result shows that escaping a language cocoon requires more than switching languages: successful cross-lingual search depends on both covering the correct languages and connecting the evidence found across them.
articles.titleCn: CocoonBench：多语言搜索代理能否摆脱语言信息茧房？
articles.abstractCn: 多语言搜索代理可以访问全球网络，但可能仍被困在证据不足的语言环境中；我们将这种失败称为语言信息茧。然而，现有的搜索基准主要在单一语言内运行，尤其是英语，忽略了跨语言的实体连接。我们引入了CocoonBench，这是一个评估多语言搜索代理能否摆脱此类语言信息茧的基准。CocoonBench从冻结的Wikidata衍生图中挖掘以答案为中心的关联路径，并选择那些单独必要且共同唯一识别答案的线索集。使用特定语言的实体名称，它记录每个任务的最低语言覆盖范围，移除直接标识符，并将每个任务呈现为三种语言的匹配提示，连同其构建证书和来源。在10个最先进的模型中，CocoonBench上的平均准确率从33.8%（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）到69.7%（Claude-Opus-4.8），即使是最强的系统也低于70%。相同的构建证书支持路径对齐轨迹分析，能够诊断模型在语言路由、证据路径恢复和答案使用方面的失败。结果表明，摆脱语言茧不仅需要切换语言：成功的跨语言搜索取决于正确覆盖语言以及连接跨语言发现的证据。

articles.title: Hard to Translate, Harder to Detect: Human Analysis Remains Essential in AI Meme Translation
articles.abstract: We present a dataset and evaluation setup for a problem in creative machine translation: translating culturally loaded passages that carry much of a text's meaning and humor that may depend on subtle or implicit discourse. We study Soviet comedy quotations that function as memes in Russian-language communication. Off-the-shelf difficulty estimators do not find these passages; current models searching the web find most but not all of them, but their own analyses of the difficulty do not help translation as well as a human-validated one. Given a brief human-validated analysis of why each passage is difficult, older models improve modestly; the strongest current translators (GPT-6 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5) improve more, and in human evaluation GPT-6 Sol comes close to the approved references on most films. Newer models have thus become much better at using such an analysis while still not reliably producing it themselves. We release (1) a dataset of five films' Russian subtitles with their audience-selected culturally salient passages, human-validated analyses, and reference translations (into English, Galician, and Spanish), together with every full-film LLM translation and evaluation produced in this study; and (2) an item-level MQM-style evaluation protocol that measures translator and evaluator noise to set the number of runs the evaluation needs, and whose automatic version tracks human judgment of these passages, which reference-free neural metrics do not, whether they score the whole text or the passages alone.
