articles.titleCn: 难以翻译，更难检测：人类分析在AI表情包翻译中仍至关重要
articles.abstractCn: 我们针对创造性机器翻译中的一个难题——翻译承载大量文本意义和幽默的文化负载段落，这些段落的含义和幽默可能依赖于微妙或隐含的语篇——提出了一种数据集和评估方案。我们研究的是在俄语交流中作为迷因（meme）使用的苏联喜剧引语。现成的难度评估工具无法识别这些段落；当前在网络上搜索的模型能找到大部分但并非全部此类段落，但它们自身的难度分析在翻译方面的帮助不如人工验证的分析。给定对每个段落为何困难的简短人工验证分析，旧模型的表现略有提升；而当前最强大的翻译器（GPT-6 Sol和Claude Opus 5.5）则有更显著的改进，在人工评估中，GPT-6 Sol在大多数电影上接近批准参考译文。因此，新模型在使用此类分析方面已大幅提升，但仍无法可靠地自行生成。我们发布了（1）一个包含五部电影俄语字幕及其观众选定的文化显著段落、人工验证分析以及参考译文（英语、加利西亚语和西班牙语）的数据集，以及本研究中生成的所有完整电影LLM翻译和评估；（2）一个基于MQM风格的逐项级评估协议，该协议测量翻译器和评估器的噪声以确定评估所需的运行次数，其自动版本追踪对这些段落的人工判断，而无需参考的无参考神经指标则无法做到这一点，无论它们评估的是整篇文本还是仅评估段落。

articles.title: Lowering the Bar for Everyone: Hidden Validation-Seeking Goals in Empathetic RL
articles.abstract: When RL learns from the reactions of many users, the policy usually cannot see what each user wants. We ask what it learns from users who privately want validation: to validate them alone (targeting), or to lower its bar for endorsing everyone (a threshold shift). We answer this in one setting, empathetic RL against LLM-simulated users (RLVER, GRPO, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct): we vary only the share of validation-seeking users (0--50%; RLVER's default: 24.6%) and evaluate on 1,000 Reddit AITA posts with community fault verdicts. The policy shifts its threshold. Endorsement of at-fault posters rises by 3--4 percentage points per 10 points of share; without such users the Qwen model stays at base, and the effect persists at matched KL and under a goal-blind reward. Signal-detection analysis shows that the criterion for endorsing falls while discrimination between at-fault and not-at-fault posters does not decline. An explicit request to be told if one is wrong gives no measurable protection: at-fault posters who make it receive nearly the same rise as those who do not (+0.11 vs. +0.13). When the goal is stated during training, the policy instead largely targets, endorsing seekers regardless of fault. Standard sycophancy and empathy benchmarks miss the shift; five of six usable released empathetic-RL checkpoints also endorse at-fault posters who ask for honesty more than their base models, though a pre-registered prediction for two held for only one. The user mix is a training hyperparameter to audit and report.
articles.titleCn: 为所有人降低门槛：共情强化学习中的隐藏验证需求目标
articles.abstractCn: 当强化学习（RL）从众多用户的反应中学习时，策略通常无法了解每个用户的具体需求。我们探究了RL从那些私下寻求验证的用户身上学到了什么：是仅针对他们进行验证（目标导向），还是降低对所有用户认可的标准（阈值调整）。我们在一个特定场景中回答了这个问题，即同理心强化学习（empathetic RL）针对LLM模拟用户（RLVER、GRPO、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）：我们仅改变寻求验证用户的比例（0--50%；RLVER的默认值为24.6%），并在包含社区判定有错案例的1,000篇Reddit AITA帖子上进行评估。策略调整了其阈值。对有错帖子的认可率每增加10个百分点，寻求验证用户的比例就上升3--4个百分点；在没有这类用户的情况下，Qwen模型保持基准水平，且这种效应在匹配KL散度及目标盲奖励下依然存在。信号检测分析表明，认可标准下降，而有错与无错帖子的区分能力并未减弱。明确要求告知错误与否的请求并未提供可测量的保护：被要求告知错误的犯错帖子与未被要求的犯错帖子相比，认可率上升几乎相同（+0.11 vs. +0.13）。当训练时明确目标时，策略则主要进行目标导向，无论是否有错都认可寻求者。标准的谄媚与同理心基准未能捕捉到这种转变；六个可用的可用发布的同理心RL检查点中有五个，对那些要求诚实的有错帖子认可率高于其基准模型，尽管预先注册的预测中只有一个是正确的。用户组合是审计和报告的训练超参数。

articles.title: Synthetic Twins: Closing the Gap Between TTS Test Sets and Real Recordings in Turkish ASR Evaluation
articles.abstract: Speech synthesized by text-to-speech engines is a low-cost substitute for recorded test sets in automatic speech recognition, yet an off-the-shelf synthetic test set is worth only a few dozen real recordings for estimating the real error rate of a recognizer. This paper examines which properties of real recordings are missing from synthetic speech and how much of the gap can be closed. For 507 Turkish Common Voice recordings, synthetic twins are built: a ladder of synthetic copies that adds, one factor at a time, the pitch of the speaker, a clone of the same speaker, the real recording channel and the speaking rate. At each step, the agreement between ASR behaviour on the copy and on the real recording is measured. Across three zero-shot cloning engines and panels of six and 19 recognizers, the speaker clone is the step that improves agreement on which sentences are hard, raising the Spearman correlation from .41 to .55 for Chatterbox. Matching the channel or adding generic noise corrects the error level when the synthetic speech is easier than real speech. The twin with the highest worth is equivalent to 70 to 122 real recordings, depending on the recognizer panel, compared with about 9 for a stock voice. The findings replicate on VoxForge, a second corpus in which speaker identity is known rather than inferred: the clone raises sentence agreement from .31 to .50 and the worth from 8 to about 50 recordings. Agreement on which sentences are hard is distinct from agreement on how hard they are. The paper concludes with a practical recipe and a reporting checklist for synthetic ASR test sets.
articles.titleCn: 合成孪生：缩小土耳其语音识别评估中TTS测试集与真实录音之间的差距
articles.abstractCn: 由文本转语音引擎合成的语音是自动语音识别中录制测试集的低成本替代品，但现成的合成测试集仅相当于几十个真实录音，用于评估识别器的真实错误率。本文探讨了真实录音缺失于合成语音的哪些特性，以及这些差距有多大程度可以弥补。针对507个土耳其Common Voice录音，构建了合成双胞胎：一个逐个添加说话者音调、相同说话者的克隆、真实录音通道和说话速度的合成副本阶梯。在每个步骤中，测量合成副本和真实录音在自动语音识别行为上的吻合程度。在三种零样本克隆引擎和包含6个和19个识别器的面板上，说话者克隆是提高难句识别吻合程度的步骤，将Chatterbox的Spearman相关系数从0.41提高到0.55。当合成语音比真实语音更容易时，匹配通道或添加通用噪声可以纠正错误水平。价值最高的双胞胎相当于70到122个真实录音，相比之下，现成语音仅相当于约9个录音。这一发现在对VoxForge（第二个语料库，其中说话者身份是已知的而非推断的）的验证中得以复制：克隆将难句吻合度从0.31提高到0.50，价值从8提高到约50个录音。对难句识别的吻合程度与对难度的吻合程度是不同的。本文最后提供了一个合成ASR测试集的实用配方和报告清单。

articles.title: Learn the Effects, Not the Examples: Implicit ICL via Attention Patching
articles.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to adapt to new tasks from demonstrations, but repeatedly including multiple examples increases context length and inference cost. Many existing implicit ICL methods encode demonstrations as fixed vectors, limiting adaptation of the intervention to individual queries and token positions. We propose Attention-Patching, an implicit ICL method that models contextual changes in self-attention outputs through task-specific updates to attention output projections. Using query-answer pairs processed with and without a fixed demonstration set, Attention-Patching fits layer-wise affine transformations from non-contextual attention representations to the demonstration-induced output changes. Across 12 classification benchmarks and four model families, Attention-Patching achieves higher average accuracy than the evaluated implicit ICL baselines while maintaining performance comparable to explicit ICL at near zero-shot inference cost. Further experiments on diverse generation tasks demonstrate its applicability to autoregressive multi-token generation.
articles.titleCn: 学习效应，而非例子：通过注意力补丁实现的隐式交互式案例学习
articles.abstractCn: 情境学习（ICL）使语言模型能够通过示例适应新任务，但反复包含多个示例会增加上下文长度和推理成本。许多现有的隐式ICL方法将示例编码为固定向量，限制了干预对单个查询和标记位置适应的能力。我们提出了Attention-Patching，这是一种隐式ICL方法，通过针对特定任务的注意力输出投影更新来模拟自注意力输出中的上下文变化。使用包含和不包含固定示例集处理的查询-答案对，Attention-Patching将非上下文注意力表示到示例诱导输出变化的逐层仿射变换进行拟合。在12个分类基准和四个模型家族中，Attention-Patching比评估的隐式ICL基线实现了更高的平均准确率，同时保持了与显式ICL相当的性能，且在接近零样本推理成本的情况下。在不同生成任务上的进一步实验展示了其在自回归多标记生成方面的适用性。

articles.title: Empirical Margin Sensitivity: An Interventional Neuron-Level Probe of Post-Trained Medical LLMs
articles.abstract: Medical post-training raises benchmark accuracy, but accuracy does not show which internal components a model's decisions depend on, or whether components that support one benchmark also support another. We apply the weight-space intervention paradigm of ROME and MEMIT at the granularity of one MLP down-projection column. Our measurement, Empirical Margin Sensitivity (EMS), replaces each coordinate magnitude of a column by its mean while preserving the column's sign pattern and L1 scale, and records the resulting change in the logit margin between the correct option and its hardest-wrong competitor. This isolates the margin's dependence on a column's fine-grained coordinate structure while the column stays in place. We discover high-EMS columns (anchors) on MedQA in ten public checkpoints (four general-purpose bases and six medical post-trained variants) across the Gemma, Llama, Qwen, and AFM families, and measure the same columns on MedMCQA and PubMedQA. Mean-ablating each discovered anchor set lowers MedQA accuracy in all six post-trained models, by 6 to 28 points. In the two pure-SFT checkpoints, crushing anchors raises the PubMedQA margin on correctly answered items (negative EMS), and anchors with this property sit significantly deeper than the same model's other anchors; the four checkpoints trained with RL or mixed recipes show positive PubMedQA EMS and no significant depth shift. The depth association recurs in each of three held-out checkpoints. Because the checkpoints differ in data and pipeline as well as objective, we report these as per-checkpoint observations.
articles.titleCn: 经验边际敏感性：针对训练后医疗大型语言模型的神经元层面干预探测
articles.abstractCn: 医学后训练提升了基准测试的准确率，但准确率并不能揭示模型的决策依赖于哪些内部组件，或者支持一个基准测试的组件是否也支持另一个基准测试。我们应用了ROME和MEMIT的权重空间干预范式，在单个MLP下投影列的粒度级别上进行分析。我们的测量方法，经验边际敏感性（EMS），将每一列的坐标幅度替换为其均值，同时保留列的符号模式和L1尺度，并记录由此产生的正确选项与其最难错误竞争者之间的logit边际变化。这种方法隔离了边际对列的细粒度坐标结构的依赖，同时保持列的位置不变。我们在Gemma、Llama、Qwen和AFM系列中的十个公共检查点（包括四个通用基础模型和六个医学后训练变体）上发现了高EMS列（锚点），并在MedMCQA和PubMedQA上测量了相同的列。平均删除每个发现的锚点集降低了所有六个后训练模型的MedQA准确率，幅度为6到28个百分点。在两个纯SFT检查点中，压碎锚点提高了正确回答项的PubMedQA边际（负EMS），具有这种属性的锚点明显比同一模型的其它锚点更深；使用RL或混合配方训练的四个检查点显示出正的PubMedQA EMS，且没有显著的深度变化。这种深度关联在每个保留的三个检查点中重现。由于检查点在数据、流程和目标上存在差异，我们按检查点报告了这些观察结果。

articles.title: Uncovering the Tells: Efficient Black-Box Audits for LLM Data Contamination
articles.abstract: Existing methods for assessing training data contamination in Large Language Models achieve high accuracy, but fundamentally rely on gray-box access, rendering them inapplicable to fully black-box environments. This limitation forces auditors to rely on full-sequence sampling or rigid heuristics, both of which incur prohibitive inference costs and struggle to isolate the underlying memorization signal. To overcome this, we propose a generation-based black-box framework that infers context-induced information gain from targeted token discrepancies. We introduce a budget-constrained auditing regime, building on the empirical observation that the membership signal is highly sparse and concentrated in a few highly informative tokens. We formalize this sparsity, showing why uniform sampling needs many more samples than a policy that targets informative positions. Empirically, our approach achieves state-of-the-art black-box separation accuracy while needing about 3x fewer queries than uniform position sampling. Finally, we apply this methodology to closed frontier models, exploring its capacity and limits in surfacing potential training data overlaps on commercial APIs.
articles.titleCn: 揭示线索：面向LLM数据污染的高效黑盒审计
articles.abstractCn: 现有的评估大型语言模型训练数据污染的方法虽然精度很高，但根本上依赖于灰盒访问，导致它们不适用于完全黑盒环境。这一局限性迫使审计人员依赖全序列采样或僵化的启发式方法，这两种方法都会产生过高的推理成本，并且难以分离出潜在的内存信号。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了一种基于生成的黑盒框架，通过分析目标标记差异来推断上下文诱导的信息增益。我们引入了一种预算约束的审计机制，基于实证观察——即成员信号高度稀疏，并且集中在少数几个信息量大的标记中。我们形式化了这种稀疏性，表明均匀采样需要比针对信息量大位置的政策多得多的样本。实证结果表明，我们的方法在黑盒分离精度上达到了当前最佳水平，同时所需的查询次数比均匀位置采样少约3倍。最后，我们将该方法应用于封闭前沿模型，探索其在商业API上揭示潜在训练数据重叠的能力和局限性。

articles.title: From Rewarding What Models Say to How They Think: Attention Process Reward Model for LLM Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an important component in large language models (LLMs). However, existing RL approaches focus on final outputs or textual solution trajectories, leading to coarse-grained rewards and unreliable reasoning. Such paradigms focus mainly on what the model outputs while overlooking how the model internally reasons. Therefore, can we reward how a model thinks internally rather than merely what it says? We first reveal the problem of textual reward aliasing in existing reward modeling approaches. Motivated by this, we propose the Attention Process Reward Model (APRM), which assigns internal rewards based on hidden states and attention maps to capture high-quality reasoning patterns. With only approximately 46M parameters, APRM is trained using ranking and counterfactual objectives, and its reward guides RL optimization while being periodically updated to handle distribution shifts. Integrated with representative RL methods, APRM achieved an average pass@8 gain of 2.88\%. Our results demonstrate the promise of incorporating internal reasoning signals into RL for LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 从奖励模型所说的内容到它们如何思考：用于大型语言模型强化学习的注意力过程奖励模型
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习（RL）已成为大型语言模型（LLMs）的重要组成部分。然而，现有的RL方法主要关注最终输出或文本解轨迹，导致粒度粗糙的奖励和不可靠的推理。这些范式主要关注模型输出的内容，而忽略了模型内部的推理过程。因此，我们能否奖励模型的内部思考过程，而不仅仅是它所说的内容？我们首先揭示了现有奖励建模方法中存在的文本奖励别名问题。基于此，我们提出了注意力过程奖励模型（APRM），该模型根据隐藏状态和注意力图分配内部奖励，以捕捉高质量的推理模式。仅包含约4600万参数的APRM，通过排序和反事实目标进行训练，其奖励指导RL优化，同时定期更新以处理分布偏移。与代表性RL方法结合使用时，APRM实现了平均pass@8提升2.88%。我们的结果表明，将内部推理信号融入LLMs的RL中具有广阔的应用前景。

articles.title: Does the Mixer Matter ? Paired-Seed Ablations of Tiny Bilingual Language Models
articles.abstract: We report paired-seed architecture ablations from the development of Sophea Artemis, our in-house Greek-English model family. Every arm trains on the same 3B targets with a shared tokenizer and recipe; models range from 54M to 759M total parameters and roughly 54M to 124M active parameters. The main finding is that, at this tiny scale, stored capacity matters far more than mixer design. On a fixed held-out test, replacing the dense feed-forward blocks of a recurrent/attention hybrid with sixteen routed experts, at nearly the same approximate active parameters, lowers loss by 0.079 (Greek) and 0.112 (English) nats per target, and doubling to 32 experts lowers it by a further 0.022 and 0.031, at every paired seed. Reusing a four-layer block three times recovers about 40-44% of the gap between a shallow and an independently deep model, consistent with looped-Transformer results. In contrast, the choice among grouped-query attention (GQA), Gated DeltaNet (GDN) hybrids and a Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) hybrid moves loss by only about 0.01-0.02 nats; a 1:1 GDN/GQA hybrid is the one dense variant that improves on GQA in both languages at every held-out seed. In bits per character, Greek and English held-out losses are similar despite a 74.49%/25.51% training split, and synthetic mathematics, which comes from a collection outside the training sources, is the hardest Greek test component and gains least from added experts. Cached decoding needs its own qualification: trained models passed cached-versus-full logit checks only under a fixed-reduction inference policy, which itself changes 1.4-2.8% of next-token argmax choices relative to native evaluation. All results are conditional on one recipe and scale.
articles.titleCn: 混合器重要吗？微型双语语言模型的成对种子消融研究
articles.abstractCn: 我们报告了Sophea Artemis（我们内部研发的希腊-英语模型家族）的成对种子架构消融实验。每个分支都在相同的3B目标上训练，并共享分词器和训练方案；模型参数总量从54M到759M不等，活跃参数量大致在54M到124M之间。主要发现是，在这个小规模下，存储容量远比混合器设计重要。在固定的保留测试集上，用16个路由专家替换循环/注意力混合模型中的密集前馈块，在几乎相同的活跃参数量下，希腊语和英语的损失分别降低了0.079和0.112 nat/目标；增加到32个专家后，损失进一步降低了0.022和0.031 nat/目标，且在每个成对种子上都保持一致。重复使用四层块三次，可恢复浅层模型与独立深层模型之间约40-44%的差距，与循环Transformer结果一致。相比之下，分组查询注意力（GQA）、门控DeltaNet（GDN）混合和Kimi Delta注意力（KDA）混合对损失的影响仅约0.01-0.02 nat；1:1的GDN/GQA混合是唯一在两种语言中所有保留种子上都优于GQA的密集变体。按字符计算，尽管训练集比例分别为74.49%/25.51%，但希腊语和英语的保留损失相似，而来自训练源外集合的合成数学是希腊语最难测试的部分，且从增加专家中获益最少。缓存解码需要单独评估：训练模型仅在固定缩减推理策略下通过缓存与完整logit检查，而该策略本身相对于原生评估会改变1.4-2.8%的下一个token的argmax选择。所有结果均基于一个训练方案和规模。

articles.title: Auxiliary Clues Aware's Geometry Problem Solving
articles.abstract: Geometry Problem Solving (GPS) serves as a rigorous test of the complex reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), particularly when solutions require auxiliary constructions absent from the input diagram. However, explicit diagramming methods suffer from unstable image generation quality and cascading errors, while existing implicit attention mechanisms primarily focus on visible elements, limiting their ability to support reasoning that requires additional geometric constructions. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{AuxCA} (Auxiliary-Clues-Aware GRPO), a reinforcement learning framework that helps models learn transferable auxiliary-construction strategies that can be applied beyond the training domain without explicit diagram generation at inference time. Specifically, we introduce Auxiliary Clues Dependency (\textbf{ACD}) to quantify the influence of auxiliary visual clues on token generation and integrate it into GRPO through fine-grained advantage weighting. Furthermore, we incorporate an auxiliary incentive reward to encourage the effective use of auxiliary geometric clues in correct solutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AuxCA-8B outperforms the explicit-plotting baseline Bagel-Canvas and achieves competitive performance with leading proprietary models on auxiliary-dependent plane geometry problems. Improvements on analytic geometry, solid geometry, and external benchmarks further suggest that the learned strategies can transfer beyond the training domain. Code is available at https://github.com/fukua23/AuxCA
articles.titleCn: 辅助线索感知的几何问题求解
articles.abstractCn: 几何问题求解（GPS）是对多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）复杂推理能力的严格测试，尤其是在解决方案需要输入图中未出现的辅助构造时。然而，显式绘图方法存在图像生成质量不稳定和级联错误的问题，而现有的隐式注意力机制主要关注可见元素，限制了它们支持需要额外几何构造推理的能力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了\textbf{AuxCA}（辅助线索感知GRPO），这是一个强化学习框架，帮助模型学习可迁移的辅助构造策略，这些策略可以在训练域之外无需显式生成图像的情况下应用。具体而言，我们引入了辅助线索依赖（\textbf{ACD}）来量化辅助视觉线索对标记生成的影响，并将其通过细粒度优势加权集成到GRPO中。此外，我们结合了辅助激励奖励，以鼓励在正确解决方案中有效使用辅助几何线索。大量实验表明，AuxCA-8B优于显式绘图的基线模型Bagel-Canvas，并在辅助依赖的平面几何问题上取得了与领先专有模型相当的性能。在解析几何、立体几何和外部基准测试上的改进进一步表明，所学习的策略可以迁移到训练域之外。代码可在https://github.com/fukua23/AuxCA获取。

articles.title: Quantizing Diffusion LLMs under Parallel Decoding: Commitment Risk and the Parallelism Tax
articles.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are served with accelerated decoders that cache context and commit, in one step, every masked position whose confidence clears a threshold. Yet post-training quantization of dLLMs has so far been calibrated and evaluated under fixed-step samplers without caching. We study W4A4 quantization under the deployed decoder and find that the decoder determines both where quantization harms accuracy and what it costs. Irreversible errors enter chiefly through forced commitments, made when no position clears the threshold: they are a minority of commitments but carry most quantization-induced flips. Quantization also levies a parallelism tax, extra forward passes per response: by compressing top logit gaps, it pushes positions below the threshold while leaving predictions largely intact. We propose DECAL, which reweights layer-wise calibration by a commitment-risk prior measured on the deployed decoder, and an argmax-preserving commit temperature that recovers the tax. On LLaDA and Dream, DECAL attains the best average accuracy among W4A4 methods, with lower run-to-run variance than the closest existing calibration method.
articles.titleCn: 在并行解码下量化扩散式大语言模型：承诺风险与并行代价
articles.abstractCn: 扩散大型语言模型（dLLMs）配备了加速解码器，该解码器缓存上下文，并在一个步骤中提交所有置信度超过阈值的掩码位置。然而，迄今为止，dLLMs的离线量化一直是在没有缓存的固定步长采样器下进行校准和评估的。我们研究了在部署解码器下的W4A4量化，发现解码器既决定了量化如何损害精度，也决定了其成本。不可逆错误主要通过强制提交引入，即当没有位置超过阈值时：这些提交是少数，但携带了大部分量化引起的翻转。量化还征收并行性税，即每个响应的额外前向传递：通过压缩顶部logit间隙，它将位置推至阈值以下，同时基本保留预测。我们提出了DECAL，它通过在部署解码器上测量的提交风险先验重新加权逐层校准，并采用一个保持argmax的提交温度来恢复税收。在LLaDA和Dream上，DECAL在W4A4方法中实现了最佳平均精度，并且比最接近的现有校准方法的运行间方差更低。

articles.title: Interrogation Protocols for AI Control
articles.abstract: As the intelligence of an AI agent increases relative to a trusted monitor, so does the risk that the monitor will fail to understand the agent's actions or to evaluate them confidently. We introduce interrogation protocols to a high-stakes AI control setting, and allow the monitor to ask the untrusted agent questions about confusing actions. For interrogation to improve safety, a weaker model must be able to distinguish misleading explanations produced by an attack policy from genuine ones produced by an honest policy. We find that on a held-out subset of BashArena, an interrogation protocol improves safety at a 1% audit budget from 72.6% for an actions-only baseline, which does not use interrogations, to 79.5% (+7.0 pp [+0.9, +20.1], 95% paired bootstrap interval), but most of this uplift can be captured by having a trusted model state a specific concern. More broadly, our work suggests that interrogating agents can improve safety, allowing monitors to catch more attacks at a larger capability gap.
articles.comment: 26 pages (8 main + references and appendix), 21 figures, 4 tables. Under review. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/interrogation-protocols-A11B/
articles.titleCn: 人工智能控制的审讯规程
articles.abstractCn: 随着AI代理的智能相对于可信监视器不断提升，监视器未能理解代理行为或自信评估它们的风险也随之增加。我们在高风险AI控制环境中引入了审问协议，允许监视器就令人困惑的行为向不受信任的代理提问。为了使审问提高安全性，一个较弱的模型必须能够区分攻击策略产生的误导性解释与诚实策略产生的真实解释。我们发现，在BashArena的保留子集上，一个审问协议在1%的审计预算下将安全性从不使用审问的行为基线72.6%提高到79.5% (+7.0 pp [+0.9, +20.1], 95%配对自举区间)，但其中大部分提升可以通过让可信模型陈述特定关切来捕获。更广泛地说，我们的工作表明，审问代理可以提高安全性，使监视器能够在更大的能力差距下捕捉到更多攻击。

articles.title: Seeing Is Locating: Spatial Awareness and Geographic Bias in Decision Language Models
articles.abstract: Decision models, which output probability distributions over candidate labels instead of generating text, are increasingly used as classifiers and evaluators for inputs associated with real-world locations. However, it remains unclear whether they can leverage spatial context and whether their predictions are geographically biased. We introduce GeoDecisions, a multimodal benchmark for evaluating the spatial awareness and geographic bias of decision models. GeoDecisions comprises two tasks: (1) geo-aware image classification, and (2) location rating on objective and subjective topics. Evaluating six decision models against supervised task-specific models, we find that spatial awareness requires vision: textual coordinates alone provide insufficient context for classifying everyday photos and satellite images. We also find substantial geographic bias. On everyday photos, despite achieving higher accuracy, open-weight decision models exhibit more spatially clustered errors than supervised models. Moreover, across all five subjective topics, every decision model gives lower ratings to locations with lower socioeconomic conditions. Finally, we propose a training-free method that combines decision models with a location prior to improve their spatial awareness without substantially increasing performance bias. Our code is available at https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/GeoDecisions.
articles.titleCn: 看见即定位：决策语言模型中的空间感知与地理偏见
articles.abstractCn: 输出概率分布而非生成文本的决策模型正越来越多地被用作对与现实世界地点相关的输入进行分类和评估的工具。然而，它们是否能够利用空间上下文以及其预测是否存在地域偏见仍不明确。我们引入了GeoDecisions，一个用于评估决策模型空间感知能力和地域偏见的跨模态基准。GeoDecisions包含两个任务：(1) 具有地理感知的图像分类，以及(2) 对客观和主观主题的地点评分。通过将六种决策模型与特定任务的监督模型进行对比评估，我们发现空间感知需要视觉能力：仅文本坐标提供的上下文不足以对日常照片和卫星图像进行分类。我们还发现存在显著的地理偏见。在日常照片上，尽管准确率更高，开放式权重决策模型比监督模型表现出更明显的空间聚集性错误。此外，在所有五个主观主题中，每种决策模型都对社会经济条件较差的地点给出较低评分。最后，我们提出了一种无需训练的方法，将决策模型与地点先验结合，以在不显著增加性能偏见的情况下提高其空间感知能力。我们的代码可在https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/GeoDecisions获取。

articles.title: Body and Soul: Decoupling Robotic Brain and Policy with RoboHarness-Zero
articles.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can execute individual skills but fail to complete tasks that require combining several of them. In our audit of Xiaomi-Robotics-1, an estimated 43\% of failures involve choosing the wrong target or losing track of task progress. Wrapping a frozen VLA in a vision-language model (VLM) harness is a natural remedy. Existing harnesses can gain substantially from task- and policy-specific preparation, raising the question of how much of that gain transfers to a new task or policy. An ideal harness should (i) need minimal preparation for a new task, (ii) need no redesign for a new policy, and (iii) preserve standalone capabilities the policy already has. To the best of our knowledge, our \ours{} is the first harness built this way. Its premise is that choosing targets and tracking progress are easy for a VLM such as GPT-6 without task preparation, while the frozen VLA already handles continuous, contact-rich motion. The frozen VLA therefore executes continuous control while the VLM plans zero-shot and monitors execution; when progress stalls or targets drift, the VLM first rephrases the instruction and, only as a fallback, executes short generated code over generic motion primitives before returning fine control to the VLA. The supervision rules stay fixed across policies, requiring only a thin interface adapter and an automatically profiled skill configuration per policy. On 200 RoboCasa365 scenes, \ours{} with GPT-6 Astra raises the success rate of frozen Xiaomi-Robotics-1 from \textbf{\color{blue}57.5\%} to \textbf{\color{blue}70.5\%} and preserves \textbf{\color{blue}90.4\%} of its standalone successes (104/115) while rescuing 37 of 85 failures. On a shared 50-scene subset, the same rules add 8 to 10 percentage points to each of four other frozen policies, while existing preparation-based harness systems often fail to transfer to a new policy.
articles.titleCn: 身心分离：使用RoboHarness-Zero解耦机器人大脑与策略
articles.abstractCn: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略可以执行单个技能，但无法完成需要结合多个技能的任务。在对小米机器人1（Xiaomi-Robotics-1）的审计中，估计43%的失败涉及选择错误的目标或丢失任务进度。将冻结的VLA封装在视觉-语言模型（VLM）框架中是一种自然的解决方案。现有的框架可以从针对任务和政策的具体准备中显著获益，这引发了如何将这种收益转移到新任务或新政策的问题。理想的框架应该（i）对新任务需要最小的准备，（ii）对新政策无需重新设计，（iii）保留政策已有的独立能力。据我们所知，我们的框架是第一个按这种方式构建的。其前提是，对于GPT-6这样的VLM，无需任务准备即可轻松选择目标并跟踪进度，而冻结的VLA已经处理了连续的、富含接触的运动。因此，冻结的VLA执行连续控制，而VLM进行零样本规划和监控执行；当进度停滞或目标漂移时，VLM首先重述指令，并且仅在后备情况下，在通用运动基元上执行生成的短代码，然后返回精细控制给VLA。监督规则在所有政策中保持固定，只需要一个薄接口适配器以及每个政策自动配置的技能配置。在200个RoboCasa365场景中，我们的框架配合GPT-6 Astra将冻结的Xiaomi-Robotics-1的成功率从57.5%提高到70.5%，同时保留了90.4%的独立成功率（104/115），并挽救了85次失败中的37次。在一个共享的50场景子集中，相同的规则为其他四个冻结政策每个增加了8到10个百分点，而现有的基于准备工作的框架系统往往无法转移到新政策。

articles.title: CyberDualEval: Measuring Dual-Use Cyber Risks in Frontier Language Models
articles.abstract: While frontier language models are becoming capable cybersecurity assistants, they also create a dual-use cyber risk: the same capabilities that help defenders identify and analyze vulnerabilities can similarly help attackers weaponize them. Existing cyber benchmarks measure either raw offensive capability or generic refusal behavior, overlooking the dual-use cyber assessment of preserving benign security utility while refusing assistance that materially advances misuse. We introduce CyberDualEval, a benchmark with 430 vulnerable tasks for measuring dual-use cyber risk in frontier language models. Each task is decomposed into three phases of increasing operationalization: security analysis, proof-of-concept generation, and exploit generation. To quantify the residual cyber risk, we annotate each task with a Task Weaponization Score that measures how much work remains to turn the resulting artifact into unauthorized cyber misuse. CyberDualEval assesses ten closed- and open-weight language models both on correct compliance and on task performance, developing four deterministic mechanisms for determining per-phase success on a large subset of the dataset. Our evaluation reveals that none of the existing frontier models effectively navigate helping with safe requests and refusing risky ones, characterized by being overly-cautious. On the other hand, recent open-weight models rarely refuse and demonstrate strong validated accuracy on risky requests.
articles.comment: NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets track. 21 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables
articles.titleCn: CyberDualEval：测量前沿语言模型中的双用网络风险
articles.abstractCn: 随着前沿语言模型逐渐成为网络安全助手，它们也带来了双重用途的网络安全风险：帮助防御者识别和分析漏洞的能力同样可能被攻击者用来武器化这些漏洞。现有的网络安全基准要么衡量原始的攻击能力，要么衡量通用的拒绝行为，忽略了在保留良性安全效用同时拒绝实质性促进滥用的协助的双重用途网络安全评估。我们引入了CyberDualEval，这是一个包含430个易受攻击任务的基准，用于衡量前沿语言模型中的双重用途网络安全风险。每个任务被分解为三个逐步增加操作化的阶段：安全分析、概念验证生成和漏洞生成。为了量化残余的网络安全风险，我们为每个任务标注了任务武器化分数，该分数衡量将生成的结果转化为未经授权的网络安全滥用所需的工作量。CyberDualEval在十个封闭权重和开放权重语言模型上进行了评估，既评估了正确合规性，也评估了任务性能，并针对数据集的大多数部分开发了四种确定性机制来判定每个阶段的成功。我们的评估表明，现有的前沿模型都无法有效应对安全请求的协助和拒绝风险请求，其特点是过于谨慎。另一方面，近期的开放权重模型很少拒绝，并在风险请求上表现出很强的验证准确性。

articles.title: When Does Continual Pre-Training Help? An Empirical Study of Decoupled Knowledge and Generation Trajectories in Clinical LLMs
articles.abstract: Continual pre-training (\textit{CPT}) is a standard route for domain adaptation, yet existing studies typically track pre-training loss or multiple-choice question answering (\textit{MCQA}) accuracy alone, offering only a narrow view of how adaptation unfolds. We jointly track factual knowledge via \textit{MCQA} and open-ended behavior via pairwise preference rankings across $18$ checkpoints for each of eight instruction-tuned \textit{Qwen} models ($0.5B$ to $8B$), adapted to German medicine with \textit{CPT} and \textit{SLERP} merging. The two axes converge at consistently different rates, with preference rankings reaching $90\%$ of their total gain after a median of $1.7B$ tokens versus $3.5B$ for \textit{MCQA}. A judge-free token-distribution measure reaches this threshold at $1.9B$ tokens. Per-aspect scores indicate that these early preference gains largely reflect surface alignment, meaning models can sound domain-appropriate before their factual knowledge catches up. Larger adapted models close more of the gap to unadapted next-tier generalists, whereas preference gain per FLOP falls by about an order of magnitude across our size range. We therefore argue that judge-based preference scores, which can plateau while \textit{MCQA} knowledge is still improving, should not be used alone to infer adaptation convergence or domain readiness.
articles.comment: EAccepted at EACL 2027 (Main Conference). 26 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables
articles.titleCn: 持续预训练何时有效？临床大语言模型解耦知识与生成轨迹的实证研究
articles.abstractCn: 持续预训练（CPT）是领域适应的标准方法，但现有研究通常仅追踪预训练损失或多项选择题回答（MCQA）的准确率，仅提供了适应过程的一个狭窄视角。我们通过MCQA联合追踪事实性知识，并通过18个检查点之间的成对偏好排名追踪开放式行为，针对八种指令调优的Qwen模型（0.5B至8B），使用CPT和SLERP合并方法将其适应到德语医学领域。这两个轴以不同的速率收敛，偏好排名在1.7B个token的中位数后达到其总增益的90%，而MCQA则需要3.5B个token。一个无裁判的token分布度量在1.9B个token时达到此阈值。按方面评分表明，这些早期的偏好增益主要反映了表面一致性，这意味着模型在事实性知识赶上之前就可以听起来符合领域。更大的适应模型缩小了与未适应的下一级通用模型的差距，而每FLOP的偏好增益在我们的大小范围内下降了约一个数量级。因此，我们主张基于裁判的偏好评分，即使MCQA知识仍在改进，也可能达到平台期，不应单独用于推断适应收敛或领域准备就绪。

articles.title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Contrastive Decoding for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Contrastive decoding (CD) mitigates object hallucination in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by contrasting token distributions under different conditions to adjust token scores. However, existing generative and discriminative benchmarks primarily measure final task scores, which can be confounded by candidate filtering, changes in generation trajectories, and response biases, making it difficult to isolate the effects of the underlying contrastive adjustments. To address these limitations while complementing existing evaluations, we introduce CONCOR (Contrastive Correction Evaluation), a controlled benchmark that directly evaluates the competition between ground-truth and different types of hallucinated candidates using the Contrastive Grounding Margin (CGM). CGM also enables analysis of directional consistency, composition, and reliability of contrastive corrections. Our evaluation reveals that existing CD methods exhibit distinct correction behaviors: some consistently favor ground-truth candidates, whereas others produce strong corrections but also introduce more errors. Crucially, these differences help explain their contrasting responses to increased contrast strength, which improves some methods while degrading others. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating the contrastive correction itself, rather than relying solely on final-output performance, and CONCOR provides a controlled and interpretable framework for understanding and improving CD methods for hallucination mitigation.
articles.titleCn: 重新思考多模态大语言模型中用于幻觉缓解的对比解码评估
articles.abstractCn: 对比解码（CD）通过对比不同条件下的token分布来调整token分数，从而缓解多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中的对象幻觉问题。然而，现有的生成和判别基准主要衡量最终任务分数，这些分数可能受到候选过滤、生成轨迹变化和响应偏差的影响，难以分离出底层对比调整的效果。为解决这些局限性并补充现有评估，我们引入了CONCOR（对比校正评估），这是一个受控基准，它直接使用对比基础边距（CGM）评估真实候选与不同类型幻觉候选之间的竞争。CGM还支持分析对比校正的方向一致性、组合性和可靠性。我们的评估表明，现有的CD方法表现出不同的校正行为：有些始终倾向于真实候选，而另一些则产生强烈的校正但同时也引入了更多错误。关键在于，这些差异解释了它们在对比强度增加时产生不同响应的原因，对比强度提高了某些方法，却损害了另一些方法。这些发现强调了评估对比校正本身的重要性，而不是仅仅依赖最终输出性能，CONCOR提供了一个受控且可解释的框架，用于理解和改进用于缓解幻觉的CD方法。

articles.title: Disclosure Bias in AI Reviewers
articles.abstract: AI models increasingly help to review papers, and many conferences and journals now require authors to state how they used AI. Does this AI-use statement change how an AI reviewer rates a paper, and could it change which papers are accepted? In a preliminary study, we varied only the AI-use statement of 150 ICLR 2027 submissions, in up to nine versions adapted from real statements: from no AI, through writing help and coding, to an AI research agent and an AI author. Six AI reviewers rated the versions: the decision model Jev and the language models Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 4 Argon. Across 23,652 reviews, we find that every reviewer rates papers lower on average when the statement says AI did all the work than under a statement of no AI use. The AI research agent statement lowers the rating significantly for Jev, Sonnet and Argon. We find no evidence of a disclosure bias for AI assistance: for writing help, coding and research help, no reviewer's rating differs significantly from its rating under a statement of no AI use. Whether the observed penalty changes which papers are accepted depends on more than the size of the penalty: on how finely and how consistently the reviewer separates the papers near the acceptance boundary, on whether the penalty is spread over all papers or concentrated on a few, and possibly on how many other papers disclose AI use.
articles.titleCn: 人工智能审查员中的披露偏差
articles.abstractCn: AI模型越来越多地帮助审稿，许多会议和期刊现在要求作者说明他们如何使用AI。这种AI使用声明会改变AI审稿人如何评分论文，并可能改变哪些论文被接受吗？在一项初步研究中，我们仅改变了150篇ICLR 2027提交论文的AI使用声明，最多有九个版本，这些版本改编自真实的声明：从没有使用AI，到写作辅助和编程，再到AI研究代理和AI作者。六位AI审稿人对这些版本进行了评分：决策模型Jev和语言模型Claude Haiku 5.5、Claude Sonnet 5.5、Gemini 3.8 Flash、Gemini 3.1 Pro和Gemini 4 Argon。在23,652次审稿中，我们发现当声明称AI完成了所有工作时，每位审稿人的平均评分都低于没有使用AI的声明。AI研究代理声明显著降低了Jev、Sonnet和Argon的评分。我们没有发现AI辅助披露存在偏见的证据：对于写作辅助、编程和研究辅助，没有审稿人的评分显著不同于没有使用AI声明的评分。观察到的惩罚是否改变哪些论文被接受，不仅取决于惩罚的大小：取决于审稿人如何精细且一致地分离接近接受边界的论文，取决于惩罚是分散在所有论文上还是集中在少数论文上，以及可能取决于披露AI使用的其他论文数量。

articles.title: TAP: Policy Interfaces for Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models denoise a masked canvas, making them a natural setting for selective generation decisions such as answering, waiting, clarifying, or refusing. We introduce TAP-DiLM, which adds a typed policy variable to masked diffusion LMs, and study how this policy should be attached to the denoising process. Across BERT-base, MDLMOWT, LLaDA-8B, and Dream-7B, we compare shared-vocabulary slots, dedicated slot heads, and CLS-based external heads. The results reveal a clear interface-backbone interaction: dedicated heads provide robust policy learning across scales, while sharedvocabulary heads can be effective when the LM-head geometry is favorable. A simple LMhead sharpness probe predicts when sharedhead policy internalization is reliable, giving a practical diagnostic for interface selection. Causal clamp and slot-injection tests show that dedicated policy slots can influence body denoising through feedback, especially at 8B scale. Safety-refusal experiments further show that TAP-DiLM supports competitive typed refusal behavior when trained with diverse unsafe prompts.
articles.titleCn: TAP：扩散语言模型的策略接口
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型对被遮盖的画布进行去噪，使其成为选择性生成决策（如回答、等待、澄清或拒绝）的理想环境。我们引入了TAP-DiLM，该模型在遮盖扩散语言模型中添加了一个带类型的策略变量，并研究了策略应如何附加到去噪过程中。在BERT-base、MDLMOWT、LLaDA-8B和Dream-7B上，我们比较了共享词汇槽、专用槽头和基于CLS的外部头。结果表明了清晰的接口-骨干相互作用：专用头在不同尺度上提供稳健的策略学习，而共享词汇头在语言模型头几何形状有利时可以非常有效。一个简单的语言模型头锐度探测可以预测何时共享头策略内化是可靠的，为接口选择提供了实用的诊断方法。因果钳位和槽注入测试表明，专用策略槽可以通过反馈影响主体去噪，尤其是在8B尺度上。安全拒绝实验进一步表明，当使用多样化的不安全提示进行训练时，TAP-DiLM支持竞争性的带类型拒绝行为。

articles.title: LeanReviewBench: Semantic Alignment Review in Mathematical Lean Projects
articles.abstract: Lean verifies that a proof establishes its formal proposition, but whether that proposition preserves the mathematical content of an informal source requires separate review. In project-scale formalizations, this correspondence can depend on definitions and constraints distributed across many declarations. We introduce LeanReviewBench, a benchmark for project-level semantic alignment review containing 197 versioned inputs collected from 18 real Lean projects, with 87 aligned and 110 misaligned reference judgments. Each input binds an informal mathematical target to selected formal declarations and an extracted dependency context. Construction combines development-history discovery, independent target binding, reconstruction under a common Lean environment, and Astra annotation with human review of uncertain cases. The collection spans diverse mathematical domains and includes 69 historical pairs. We evaluate six language models with Direct and ReForm prompts on all 197 inputs against final human-reviewed reference labels. GPT-6.1 Sol with Direct prompting achieves the highest reported accuracy of 0.827 and misalignment-detection F1 of 0.844; the effects of prompting vary across models. LeanReviewBench provides a testbed for reviewing semantic correspondence in existing mathematical formalization projects. LeanReviewBench is available at https://github.com/MechMath/LeanReviewBench.
articles.titleCn: LeanReviewBench：数学Lean项目中的语义对齐评审
articles.abstractCn: Lean验证证明是否确立了其形式命题，但该命题是否保留了非形式来源的数学内容需要单独审查。在项目规模的正式化中，这种对应关系可能依赖于分布在许多声明中的定义和约束。我们引入LeanReviewBench，这是一个用于项目级语义对齐审查的基准，包含从18个真实Lean项目中收集的197个版本化输入，其中87个参考判断为对齐，110个为错位。每个输入将非形式数学目标绑定到选定的正式声明和提取的依赖上下文中。构建过程结合了开发历史发现、独立目标绑定、在通用Lean环境下的重建以及Astra注释和不确定情况的人工审查。该集合涵盖了不同的数学领域，包括69对历史数据。我们在所有197个输入上使用Direct和ReForm提示评估了六种语言模型，并与最终人工审查的参考标签进行对比。GPT-6.1 Sol使用Direct提示实现了报告的最高准确率0.827和错位检测F1值0.844；提示的影响在不同模型间存在差异。LeanReviewBench为审查现有数学正式化项目中的语义对应关系提供了试验平台。LeanReviewBench可在https://github.com/MechMath/LeanReviewBench获取。

articles.title: When Does Reasoning Help Entity Disambiguation? Small LLMs In-Domain and Under Shift
articles.abstract: Entity disambiguation (mapping ambiguous mentions in text to entities in a knowledge base) is a foundational step in tasks such as knowledge graph construction, question answering, and information extraction. Recent work has applied LLMs to this problem, achieving stateof-the-art performance. Notably, reasoning LLMs have been shown to perform entity disambiguation in a true zero-shot fashion, generalizing across knowledge bases and domains. However, it is unclear whether this capability survives, or remains competitive, with smaller LLMs, where entity disambiguation has typically relied on reranking rather than reasoning. We ask when reasoning is worth its cost at small scale. We compare pointwise, listwise, and reasoning-based candidate-selection components within a classical coarse-to-fine entity disambiguation pipeline, across the classical, few-shot and true zero-shot settings. The reasoning paradigm is trained with distillation and reinforcement learning recipes. The benefit of reasoning grows with domain shift: negligible in-domain, decisive in the true zero-shot setting. We show that two distinct factors are at work: the reranker's uncertainty over the candidates locates where the paradigms disagree, while shift governs which is right when they do.
articles.titleCn: 推理何时有助于实体消歧？领域内的小型大型语言模型和领域迁移
articles.abstractCn: 实体消歧（将文本中的模糊指称映射到知识库中的实体）是知识图谱构建、问答和信息抽取等任务的基础步骤。近期研究将大型语言模型（LLMs）应用于该问题，取得了当前最佳性能。值得注意的是，推理型LLMs已被证明能够以真正的零样本方式执行实体消歧，跨知识库和领域进行泛化。然而，这种能力是否能在较小规模的LLMs中得以保留或保持竞争力尚不明确，因为在实体消歧中，较小规模的LLMs通常依赖重新排序而非推理。我们探讨了在小型规模下推理是否值得其成本。我们比较了经典粗粒度到细粒度实体消歧流程中，点式、列表式和基于推理的候选选择组件，在经典、少样本和真正零样本设置下的表现。推理范式通过蒸馏和强化学习策略进行训练。推理的优势随着领域迁移而增长：在领域内几乎可以忽略不计，而在真正零样本设置中则具有决定性作用。我们表明存在两个不同因素在起作用：重新排序器对候选的不确定性定位了范式产生分歧的地方，而迁移则决定了当它们产生分歧时哪个是正确的。

articles.title: Evaluating Persona Consistency in LLM User Simulators Without External Reference Annotations
articles.abstract: Standard evaluations assess LLM-simulated personas against an external ground truth, such as community trait annotations, but that reference is unavailable when the persona is inferred only from a short, task-oriented chat. We ask how persona consistency can be evaluated without such a reference, and propose a self-anchored internal-consistency diagnostic: the persona describes itself once and acts twice. A Likert self-report supplies a soft internal anchor; two behavioral profiles come from constrained scenario choices scored without a judge and from open-ended responses judged by an LLM. Consistency is the correlation between the self-report and each behavioral profile, in a shared six-facet BFI-2 space. The framework compares persona-construction strategies by assessing how consistently their elicited responses reflect their self-reported traits. Across ordinary-user chats (WildChat and LMSYS) and well-documented personas with community annotations (the Personality Database, PDB), profile-enriched representations agree with the anchor more closely than a raw-dialogue baseline. On PDB, this self-anchored ordering reproduces the community-annotation ordering. The pattern is stable across answering and judge models.
articles.titleCn: 在LLM用户模拟器中无需外部参考注释评估角色一致性
articles.abstractCn: 标准评估通过将LLM模拟的角色与外部基准（如社区特征标注）进行对比来衡量，但在仅从简短、任务导向的对话中推断角色时，这种基准不可用。我们探讨在缺乏此类基准的情况下如何评估角色一致性，并提出了一种自我锚定的内部一致性诊断方法：角色自我描述一次，行为表现两次。Likert自我报告提供软性内部锚点；两种行为特征分别来自无裁判评分的约束场景选择和由LLM评判的开放式回答。一致性是指自我报告与每种行为特征在共享的六维度BFI-2空间中的相关性。该框架通过评估其引发响应反映自我报告特征的一致性来比较角色构建策略。在普通用户对话（WildChat和LMSYS）以及具有社区标注的详细角色（人格数据库PDB）中，经过特征增强的表示比原始对话基线更紧密地与锚点相符。在PDB上，这种自我锚定的排序复制了社区标注的排序。该模式在不同应答和裁判模型中保持稳定。

articles.title: DUET: Dual-MDL Unsupervised Entropy-Trie Segmentation for Low-Resource Languages
articles.abstract: Morphological segmentation, the task of decomposing words into constituent morphemes, becomes particularly challenging under extreme data scarcity, a regime that can arise in language documentation and linguistic reasoning. This difficulty stems from existing approaches' reliance on annotated data, external resources, or recurring patterns that emerge only in larger corpora. To address this limitation, we propose Dual-MDL Unsupervised Entropy-Trie Segmentation (DUET), a deterministic unsupervised algorithm that decouples structural candidate generation from statistical candidate ranking. DUET combines branching entropy with recursive paradigm discovery to generate linguistically plausible candidate segmentations, then ranks them using a dual minimum description length (MDL) criterion: a corpus-level objective rewards morpheme reuse, while a construction-tree objective guards against over-segmentation. On the SIGMORPHON 2023 interlinear glossing shared task, DUET outperforms unsupervised baselines in Morpheme F1 under both the standard and simulated extremely low-resource settings, while providing broader candidate coverage. Augmenting prompts with DUET segmentations improves performance on a linguistic reasoning benchmark, yielding the best overall results among the evaluated segmentation methods.

articles.titleCn: 双模型无监督熵树分割法：用于低资源语言的DUET
articles.abstractCn: 词素切分，即将单词分解为构成词素的单元的任务，在极端数据稀缺的情况下变得尤为困难，这种情况可能出现在语言记录和语言推理中。这种困难源于现有方法对标注数据、外部资源或仅在大型语料库中出现的重复模式的依赖。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了双MDL无监督熵树切分（DUET），这是一种确定性无监督算法，将结构候选生成与统计候选排序解耦。DUET结合分支熵与递归范式发现来生成语言学上合理的候选切分，然后使用双最小描述长度（MDL）标准对其进行排序：语料库级目标奖励词素重用，而构造树目标防止过度切分。在SIGMORPHON 2023行文标注共享任务中，DUET在标准及模拟极端低资源设置下，在词素F1指标上均优于无监督基线，同时提供了更广泛的候选覆盖范围。在语言推理基准测试中，通过添加DUET切分提示，性能得到提升，在所评估的切分方法中取得了最佳整体结果。

articles.title: Voyag: Joint Multi-Intent Detection and Execution-Relation Classification for In-Vehicle Voice Assistants
articles.abstract: An in-vehicle voice assistant must decide not only which intents an utterance contains but also how co-active intents may be executed: concurrently, in a fixed order, or not at all without arbitration. We present Voyag, a single-forward decision model that jointly predicts ten controlled vehicle-intent slots and a three-way execution relation (parallel, sequential, mutually exclusive) over each co-active intent pair. Voyag combines a multilingual ModernBERT-style encoder (mmBERT-base, 306.9M parameters), a typed per-slot choice head, and a lightweight GroupCalibration relation head (1.61M parameters) that consumes marker hidden states, pooled context, explicit resource-requirement profiles, and symmetrized outer-product conflict features. All objectives are optimized in one joint loss: soft cross-entropy over slot choices, focal cross-entropy over relations, and a mutex-consistency penalty. On a synthetic Chinese vehicle-life benchmark with semantic scene-level splits and a leakage audit (30,017 / 3,473 / 5,000 groups), validation-only selection yields 0.9893 slot accuracy and 0.0526 expected calibration error over 50,000 slot decisions. Conditioned on gold intents, the relation head reaches 0.8548 accuracy, 0.8473 macro-F1, and 0.6062 mutually-exclusive recall over 4,000 pairs; end to end with one encoder forward it reaches 0.8530 accuracy and 0.8464 macro-F1. Against a two-stage rule pipeline, the aggregate end-to-end gain is small and borderline, so we claim no aggregate advantage; the learned head's advantage lies in sequential and parallel recall where surface rules are blind. We report rule baselines with a tautology disclosure and a held-out thermal conflict failure.
articles.titleCn: Voyag：针对车载语音助手的联合多意图检测与执行关系分类
articles.abstractCn: 车载语音助手不仅需要判断语音指令包含哪些意图，还需要决定如何执行协同意图：是并行执行、按固定顺序执行，还是在无需仲裁的情况下不执行。我们提出了Voyag，一种单次前向决策模型，它联合预测了十个受控车辆意图槽位，并对每对协同意图预测三种执行关系（并行、顺序、互斥）。Voyag结合了多语言ModernBERT风格编码器（mmBERT-base，306.9M参数）、分槽位的类型选择头，以及一个轻量级的GroupCalibration关系头（1.61M参数），该关系头消耗标记隐藏状态、池化上下文、显式的资源需求配置文件以及对称外积冲突特征。所有目标都在一个联合损失中进行优化：槽位选择的软交叉熵、关系选择的焦点交叉熵，以及互斥一致性惩罚。在一个包含语义场景级划分和泄漏审计的合成中文车辆生命周期基准（30,017组/3,473组/5,000组）上，仅验证选择产生了0.9893的槽位准确率和50,000次槽位决策中0.0526的预期校准误差。在给定黄金意图的情况下，关系头达到了0.8548的准确率、0.8473的宏观F1值和0.6062的互斥召回率（在4,000对中）；单编码器前向的端到端性能达到了0.8530的准确率和0.8464的宏观F1值。与两阶段规则管道相比，端到端的综合增益很小且接近临界值，因此我们声称没有综合优势；学习到的头的优势在于顺序和并行召回，而表面规则在此方面是盲目的。我们报告了包含恒真披露和排除的热冲突失败的规则基线。

articles.title: StutterStigma-TR: A Novel Turkish Dataset and Target-Aware BERT Framework for Stuttering-Related Stigma Detection
articles.abstract: Computational research on disability-related ableist harm remains limited, and condition specific resources for stuttering-related stigma are particularly scarce. This study introduces StutterStigma-TR, a Turkish dataset of 6,019 public X/Twitter posts annotated as Stigmatizing, Non-stigmatizing/contextual, or Supportive using a speech and language therapy-informed protocol with independent lived-experience evaluation. We also propose StutterStigma-BERT, a BERTurk-based target-aware framework that combines explicit target marking, target-span representation, target-conditioned context, character-level and handcrafted orthographic information, and gated discourse cues. The framework is evaluated in complementary three-class and binary settings using controlled three-seed ablation analyses and final 20-seed robustness evaluations. Under the common training protocol, Gated Discourse-OrthoTarget trained with cross-entropy is selected as the final configuration for both tasks based on internal-validation Macro-F1. Across 20 random seeds, the final three-class model achieves a mean Macro-F1 of 73.54%, while the final binary model achieves 85.17% using validation-selected decision thresholds. Task adapted harmful-language comparators are additionally evaluated under the common training protocol, and the proposed model obtains the highest mean Macro-F1 among them. For the primary three-class task, matched backbone analyses show higher internal validation Macro-F1 with BERTurk than with TurkishBERTweet or Turkish Mamba, while substantial train-validation separation persists across all three backbones. Separate direct-transfer and zero-shot experiments examine performance without StutterStigma-TR supervision. Across the task-adapted, direct-transfer, and zero-shot comparisons, the condition-specific supervised systems retain the strongest aggregate performance.
articles.titleCn: StutterStigma-TR：一个用于口吃相关污名检测的新型土耳其数据集和目标感知BERT框架
articles.abstractCn: 关于残疾相关能力主义伤害的计算研究仍然有限，而针对口吃相关污名化的特定条件资源尤为稀缺。本研究介绍了StutterStigma-TR，一个包含6,019条公开X/Twitter帖子的土耳其数据集，这些帖子根据语言治疗指导协议被标注为污名化、非污名化/情境化或支持性，并经过独立的生活经验评估。我们还提出了StutterStigma-BERT，一个基于BERTurk的目标感知框架，该框架结合了显式目标标记、目标跨度表示、目标条件化上下文、字符级和手工制作的正字法信息以及门控话语线索。该框架在互补的三分类和二分类设置中通过受控的三种子集消融分析和最终20种子集鲁棒性评估进行评估。在常见的训练协议下，基于交叉熵训练的Gated Discourse-OrthoTarget被选为两个任务的最终配置，根据内部验证的Macro-F1。在20个随机种子中，最终的三分类模型实现了平均Macro-F1为73.54%，而最终二分类模型使用验证选择的决策阈值实现了85.17%。此外，在常见的训练协议下，任务适配的有害语言比较器也进行了评估，所提出的模型在它们中获得了最高的平均Macro-F1。对于主要的三分类任务，匹配主干分析显示，与土耳其BERTweet或土耳其Mamba相比，使用BERTurk时具有更高的内部验证Macro-F1，但在所有三个主干中，训练-验证分离仍然很大。单独的直接迁移和零样本实验检验了没有StutterStigma-TR监督时的性能。在任务适配、直接迁移和零样本比较中，特定条件的监督系统保持了最强的综合性能。

articles.title: Ontology-Compiled 2D Clinical State Fields with Bidirectional Diffusion Encoders for Zero-Training Cross-Ontology Medical Coding
articles.abstract: Healthcare systems continually revise clinical taxonomies, update reimbursement schedules, and harmonize cross-border registries. Existing automated coding models bind clinical text understanding to fixed vocabulary-specific heads, requiring manual relabeling and retraining whenever code sets change. We introduce Ontology-Compiled 2D Clinical State Fields (OCSF), a vocabulary-free framework that decouples clinical document reading from target ontology indexing so one trained encoder can switch across arbitrary medical vocabularies in seconds without target training. A single-pass bidirectional diffusion-pretrained encoder and vocabulary-free decoder map each clinical note into a fixed-dimension two-dimensional state matrix with zero code-specific parameters. Any target ontology is compiled offline on CPU from public text descriptions into a scale-invariant Tikhonov deconvolution operator that suppresses sibling-code interference while preserving source decision thresholds. Trained solely on English MIMIC-IV ICD-9 discharge summaries and evaluated without target tuning across 58,706 held-out test notes and five unseen ontologies spanning English ICD-10, MS-DRG, Spanish, Greek, and Chinese (115-185,458 codes), OCSF reaches 63.15% Micro-F1 on in-domain ICD-9 (outperforming a matched closed-vocabulary classifier and eliminating late-epoch tail overfitting) and transfers directly to 26,085 English ICD-10 codes (29.23% recall at gold cardinality), MS-DRG groups, and multilingual terminologies, compiling up to 185,458 codes in under 10 seconds on CPU with sub-millisecond GPU readout.

articles.titleCn: 基于双向扩散编码器的本体编译二维临床状态场，用于零训练跨本体医疗编码
articles.abstractCn: 医疗系统持续修订临床分类法、更新报销计划并协调跨境登记系统。现有的自动编码模型将临床文本理解与固定词汇特定的头部绑定，每当代码集发生变化时都需要手动重新标记和重新训练。我们引入了本体编译二维临床状态字段（OCSF），这是一个无需词汇表的框架，将临床文档阅读与目标本体索引解耦，使得一个训练好的编码器可以在几秒钟内切换任意医疗词汇表，而无需目标训练。单次通过的双向扩散预训练编码器和无需词汇表的解码器将每条临床记录映射到一个固定维度的二维状态矩阵，其中不包含特定代码的参数。任何目标本体都可以在CPU上离线编译，从公共文本描述中生成一个尺度不变的Tikhonov反卷积算子，该算子抑制兄弟代码的干扰，同时保留源决策阈值。OCSF仅使用英语MIMIC-IV ICD-9出院记录进行训练，并在未经目标调整的情况下，在58,706条保留测试记录和五个未见过的本体（涵盖英语ICD-10、MS-DRG、西班牙语、希腊语和中文，共115-185,458个代码）上进行了评估，OCSF在领域内ICD-9上达到63.15%的Micro-F1（优于匹配的闭词汇分类器并消除了后期尾部的过拟合），并能直接迁移到26,085个英语ICD-10代码（在黄金基数下召回率为29.23%）、MS-DRG组和多语言术语，在CPU上编译高达185,458个代码，GPU读取时间小于毫秒。

articles.title: What Makes Good Data for Training Coding Agents? A Systematic Study on SWE-Gym
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) trains coding agents on software tasks whose hidden tests decide the reward, yet task collections check these tests only against the reference fix. We ask what makes a task good training data, focusing on the correctness of its reward labels. We audit SWE-Gym with two LLM families, and a suspected error counts only if execution reproduces it. We find that unsolved often means mislabelled: 74% of the tasks that a 9B base model never solves have a test that rejects correct fixes (a false negative), versus 20% of those it sometimes solves. We repair or remove such tasks, and the audited tasks that remain train better policies. At equal size and matched difficulty, models trained on them score 2.4 and 2.7 points higher on held-out tasks from SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro than models trained on the original tasks, whereas simply dropping the never-solved tasks shows no such gain. We further find that wrong patches that pass (false positives) make up about a quarter of all passing patches, and that new tests that catch a quarter of them do not change held-out scores detectably. A pass rate shows whether a task yields reward, not whether that reward is right, so the reward labels themselves must be checked. To this end, we release SWE-Gym-Verified with its 1,087 audited tasks, every verdict with its executed evidence, our training sets, and the full audit pipeline.

articles.titleCn: 什么构成了训练编码代理的良好数据？对SWE-Gym的系统研究
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习（RL）通过在软件任务上训练编码代理，这些任务的隐藏测试决定奖励，但任务集合仅将这些测试与参考修复进行校验。我们探讨什么构成了良好的训练数据，重点关注其奖励标签的正确性。我们使用两个大型语言模型（LLM）系列审计SWE-Gym，只有当执行能复现错误时，才计为疑似错误。我们发现未解决的通常意味着标签错误：9B基础模型从未解决的74%的任务中，其测试会拒绝正确的修复（假阴性），而其有时能解决的只有20%。我们修复或移除此类任务，审计后剩余的任务能更好地训练策略。在同等规模和难度匹配的情况下，使用这些任务训练的模型在SWE-bench验证集和SWE-bench专业集上的保留任务得分比使用原始任务训练的模型高2.4和2.7分，而仅移除从未解决的任务则无此提升。我们进一步发现，通过但错误的补丁（假阳性）约占所有通过补丁的四分之一，而能捕获其中四分之一的新测试对保留得分没有明显影响。通过率表明任务是否能产生奖励，而非奖励是否正确，因此奖励标签本身必须经过校验。为此，我们发布了SWE-Gym-Verified，包含其1087个审计任务、每个裁决的执行证据、我们的训练集和完整的审计流程。

articles.title: PackLoop: Row-Packed Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models under Concurrency
articles.abstract: Looped language models reuse one block of weights T times per token, trading parameters for test-time depth, but autoregressive decoding then pays T sequential passes per token. Self-speculative decoders recover 2-10x for a single request, yet their gains fade as requests share a GPU, and current practice is to speculate less as load grows. We show that what fails under load is the layout of speculative work, not speculation. In concurrent decoding the unit of cost is the row, one request advancing on one loop, which reads that loop's key-value (KV) cache once; additional positions inside a row are nearly free. Pipelined schedules such as the wavefront place every speculative position on a different loop, hence in a row of its own, so each token is still read T times. We present PackLoop, built on one principle: speculate only inside rows that are read anyway. Deep loops accumulate positions and advance them as a block in one row, context-copy proposals join the row that the first loop already reads, and a closed-form admission rule, the economic order quantity of inventory theory, sets how long to accumulate from a cost model calibrated once per engine. PackLoop is exact: in FP32 its output is token-for-token identical to autoregressive decoding, also under sampling and early exit. Across 164 load points spanning three GPUs, four Ouro models, six benchmarks, and contexts up to 32K tokens, one PackLoop configuration is faster than the best existing schedule, chosen per point, at 161 points (median 1.25x, up to 1.76x) and never significantly slower. Its lead grows with concurrency and context length, the regime in which existing self-speculation gains least.
articles.titleCn: PackLoop：并发环境下循环语言模型的行打包自推测解码
articles.abstractCn: 循环语言模型每次对每个token重复使用一个权重块T次，以用参数换取推理时的深度，但自回归解码随后会对每个token进行T次顺序传递。自推测解码器在单个请求中能提升2-10倍的效率，但它们的收益会随着请求共享GPU而减弱，当前的做法是随着负载增加而减少推测量。我们证明，在负载下失效的是推测工作的布局，而非推测本身。在并发解码中，成本单位是行，每个请求在一个循环上推进，该循环会读取该循环的键值（KV）缓存一次；行内的其他位置几乎免费。流水线调度如波前调度将每个推测位置放在不同的循环上，因此每个token仍然会被读取T次。我们提出了PackLoop，基于一个原则：只在无论如何都会读取的行内进行推测。深层循环累积位置，并将它们作为一个块在一个行中推进，上下文复制提议加入第一个循环已经读取的行，一个封闭形式的准入规则，即库存理论的经济订货量，根据每次为引擎校准的成本模型设定累积时长。PackLoop是精确的：在FP32下，它的输出与自回归解码在每个token上完全相同，包括采样和提前退出。在跨越三个GPU、四个Ouro模型、六个基准测试和最多32K token的上下文中，共164个负载点，PackLoop的配置在161个点（中位数1.25倍，最高1.76倍）比每个点选择的最佳现有调度更快，且从未显著变慢。随着并发性和上下文长度的增加，它的领先优势会扩大，这正是在现有自推测收益最少的场景中。

articles.title: VADE: A Verifiable Agent Data Engine from Professional Sources
articles.abstract: Language agents have shown their practical value, particularly in software engineering, where abundant public code and executable tests support training and evaluation at scale. Extending this success to other professional domains, such as law and finance, is not straightforward: many agent tasks involve open-ended analysis, making outcomes hard to verify and, in turn, hard to use as scalable supervision. As a result, high-quality tasks in these domains are still largely expert-authored, making them expensive to scale and limiting their use for training. To address this bottleneck, we introduce VADE, a data engine that automatically constructs verifiable analysis tasks from public sources used in professional practice. VADE exploits a simple asymmetry: professional analyses are difficult to solve because the relevant evidence must first be found and interpreted, but much easier to verify once that evidence is fixed. During task synthesis, the engine constructs a reference analysis from source evidence and asks an independent agent to reproduce its conclusions from the same evidence without seeing it. Only after the analysis is verified is it compiled into an open-ended task with an item-level scoring contract, allowing the same task to support both evaluation and training. We apply VADE across four professional domains; in an independent expert review of 186 finance tasks, 93.5% meet a high bar for source fidelity, answer correctness, and evaluation fairness. In finance, these tasks expose substantial remaining model errors, particularly unsupported facts and inferences, while training on verified solver trajectories improves held-out performance and yields gains that transfer to public finance benchmarks such as Finance Agent Benchmark v2. Together, these results suggest a practical path toward scalable, verifiable supervision for open-ended professional tasks.

articles.titleCn: VADE：来自专业来源的可验证代理数据引擎
articles.abstractCn: 语言代理已展现出其实际价值，尤其在软件工程领域，丰富的公共代码和可执行测试支持大规模的培训和评估。将这一成功扩展到其他专业领域，如法律和金融，并非易事：许多代理任务涉及开放式分析，导致结果难以验证，进而难以作为可扩展的监督。因此，这些领域的高质量任务仍主要由专家编写，使其难以规模化并限制了其用于培训。为解决这一瓶颈，我们引入了VADE，一个数据引擎，可自动从专业实践中使用的公共资源中构建可验证分析任务。VADE利用了一个简单的非对称性：专业分析之所以难以解决，是因为相关证据必须首先被找到和解释，但一旦证据固定，验证起来就容易得多。在任务合成过程中，引擎从源证据构建一个参考分析，并要求一个独立的代理从相同证据中重现其结论，而不直接看到证据。只有经过验证的分析才会被编译成一个开放式任务，并附带一个项目级评分协议，使同一任务既能支持评估也能支持培训。我们应用VADE跨越了四个专业领域；在186个金融任务的独立专家评审中，93.5%的任务达到了源忠实度、答案正确性和评估公平性的高标准。在金融领域，这些任务揭示了模型中大量的剩余错误，特别是未被支持的事实和推断，而基于已验证求解器轨迹的培训提高了未见数据的性能，并带来了可迁移到公共金融基准（如Finance Agent Benchmark v2）的收益。这些结果共同表明了一条实用路径，即实现开放式专业任务的规模化、可验证监督。

articles.title: Laya-IsoToken: Day-One Clinical Codebook Switching via Closed-Form Operator Compilation
articles.abstract: Healthcare systems periodically revise diagnostic and procedural classifications (ICD-9 to ICD-10/11), update hospital reimbursement groupers (MS-DRG), and deploy clinical coding across languages. Supervised coding networks bind clinical text encoders to fixed per-code classifier weights, forcing hospitals to re-annotate tens of thousands of records before switching codebooks, whereas standalone large language models incur high latency and hallucinate invalid codes. Here we show that day-one clinical codebook switching becomes feasible without target-labeled notes when local clinical evidence reading is decoupled from a strictly frozen multilingual concept space. Laya-IsoToken trains a clinical span reader once on source records with zero per-code classifier parameters, separating text evidence from historical disease prevalence. Given only public target code descriptions, closed-form matrix compilation aligns distributional shifts, compensates for paraphrased definitions, and deduplicates sibling codes in under three seconds, while a pre-deployment geometric residual routes unfamiliar concepts to offline language model verification. Across 32,804 MIMIC-IV ICD-9 discharges, Laya-IsoToken matches published supervised baselines (62.6% Micro-F1) while reducing active calibration error by 32%. Switched with zero target training notes to 13,783 unseen-patient ICD-10 discharges, MS-DRG groups, and multilingual cohorts, it outperforms biomedical dense retrievers, semantic crosswalks (+5.4 F1 points on ICD-10, paired $d_z = 0.49$, $p < 0.001$), and official US CMS equivalence mappings (+3.5 points, $p < 0.001$) at 9.4 ms per admission. Pairing this reader with an offline 31B verifier across 1,000 full discharge summaries lifts zero-training ICD-10 coding to 40.6% Micro-F1 (57.0% category F1, $d_z = 0.66$, $p < 0.001$) with 0.0% invalid code hallucinations.
