articles.titleCn: Laya-IsoToken：第一天临床代码切换通过闭式算子编译
articles.abstractCn: 医疗系统会定期修订诊断和操作分类（从ICD-9到ICD-10/11）、更新医院报销分组（MS-DRG），并在不同语言中部署临床编码。监督编码网络将临床文本编码器绑定到固定的每条编码分类器权重，迫使医院在切换编码手册前重新标注数万条记录，而独立的超大语言模型则存在高延迟且会生成无效编码。我们展示，在无需目标标注记录的情况下，通过将本地临床证据阅读与严格冻结的多语言概念空间解耦，即可实现首日临床编码手册切换。Laya-IsoToken在源记录上仅使用零每条编码分类器参数训练临床跨度阅读器，将文本证据与历史疾病流行率分离。仅给定公共目标编码描述，封闭式矩阵编译可对齐分布变化，补偿释义定义，并在三秒内去重同源编码，同时部署前的几何残差路由将未知概念导向离线语言模型验证。在32,804条MIMIC-IV ICD-9出院记录中，Laya-IsoToken与已发表的监督基准（62.6%微平均F1）匹配，同时将主动校准误差降低32%。切换至零目标训练记录的13,783例未知患者ICD-10出院记录、MS-DRG分组和多语言队列后，其性能优于生物医学密集检索器、语义交叉映射（在ICD-10上+5.4 F1分，配对$d_z = 0.49$，$p < 0.001$）和官方美国CMS等价映射（+3.5分，$p < 0.001$），每例入院耗时9.4毫秒。将此阅读器与离线31B验证器搭配，在1,000份完整出院记录中，零训练ICD-10编码提升至40.6%微平均F1（57.0%类别F1，$d_z = 0.66$，$p < 0.001$），且0.0%无效编码幻觉。

articles.title: Same Executions, Different Gaps: Judgment Rules in Web-Agent Evaluation
articles.abstract: Success-rate gains guide the development of web agents. Yet knowing which agent ranks first does not tell us how much confidence to place in its reported advantage. We study the comparison itself: how success is defined, what evidence supports the judgments, and how the difference between agents is estimated. On fixed web-agent executions, changing a judge from predicting likely completion to requiring recorded support can remove most of a reported lead without changing the ranking. This effect persists when unresolved completion is distinguished from supported failure. Controlled source additions explain how missing relations between task requirements, objects and observations can conceal a difference or create an apparent advantage. We also find that making both agents' score estimates more accurate can make their difference less accurate, because their original errors partly canceled. To estimate a chosen outcome difference, we combine judge predictions with reference labels for sampled task pairs. Across four released execution systems, regression fitted on the same 50 labeled pairs reduces estimation error relative to direct paired sampling. The results give agent researchers a practical basis for assessing claimed improvements: make the comparison target explicit, retain the evidence needed to check it, and use paired labels to estimate the difference directly.
articles.titleCn: 相同执行，不同差距：网络代理评估中的判断规则
articles.abstractCn: 成功率提升引导着网络代理的发展。然而，知道哪个代理排名靠前并不能告诉我们对其报告的优势应有多少信心。我们研究比较本身：成功是如何定义的，哪些证据支持判断，以及代理之间的差异是如何估计的。在固定的网络代理执行中，将裁判从预测可能完成改为要求记录支持，可以消除大部分报告的领先优势，而排名不会改变。当区分未解决的完成和支持的失败时，这种效应仍然存在。受控的源代码添加解释了任务需求、对象和观察之间缺失的关联如何掩盖差异或制造出明显的优势。我们还发现，使两个代理的得分估计更加准确，可能会使它们的差异估计不那么准确，因为它们的原始误差部分抵消了。为了估计所选结果的差异，我们将裁判的预测与样本任务对的参考标签结合起来。在四个已发布的执行系统中，对相同的50个标记对进行回归拟合，相对于直接配对采样，可以减少估计误差。这些结果为代理研究人员提供了一个实用的基础，用于评估声称的改进：明确比较目标，保留检查所需的证据，并使用配对标签直接估计差异。

articles.title: PCC: Pivotal Channel Compensation for Layer Pruning of Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Treating independent layers as the minimal pruning unit allows layer pruning to efficiently eliminate many redundant parameters and achieve high compression rates. Layer pruning has become a promising and prevalent structured pruning technique for large language models (LLMs). However, multi-layer removal can lead to significant performance degradation for LLMs. Although some works have explored various compensation methods for pruned layers, they are inefficient and costly. Observing that the expression of a large proportion of information is concentrated on a small number of pivotal channels, we propose a novel post-pruning compensation method for layer pruning, called pivotal channel compensation (PCC). PCC can achieve significant performance improvement by compensating for a small number of channels through learnable linear transformations at the pruning interface. Besides, we propose a new evaluation metric, called channel-wise average performance improvement (CAPI), which can measure the efficiency of channel-wise compensation. Our experimental results across various LLMs demonstrate that PCC can achieve significant and consistent improvements and high CAPI on language modeling and zero-shot question answering for the state-of-the-art cross-layer and consecutive-layer pruning methods. Compared with existing compensation methods, PCC can achieve competitive results with fewer additional parameters and less training cost.
articles.titleCn: PCC：大型语言模型层剪枝的Pivotal渠道补偿
articles.abstractCn: 将独立层视为最小剪枝单元，使得层剪枝能够高效地消除大量冗余参数并实现高压缩率。层剪枝已成为大型语言模型（LLM）的一种有前景且普遍的结构化剪枝技术。然而，多层移除会导致LLM性能显著下降。尽管一些研究探索了针对剪枝层的各种补偿方法，但它们效率低下且成本高昂。观察到大部分信息的表达集中在少数关键通道上，我们提出了一种新的层剪枝后剪枝补偿方法，称为关键通道补偿（PCC）。PCC可以通过在剪枝接口处对少量通道进行可学习线性变换来实现显著的性能提升。此外，我们提出了一种新的评估指标，称为通道平均性能提升（CAPI），用于衡量通道补偿的效率。我们在各种LLM上的实验结果表明，PCC在语言建模和零样本问答任务上，对于最先进的跨层和连续层剪枝方法，均能实现显著且一致的性能提升和高CAPI。与现有的补偿方法相比，PCC在更少的附加参数和更低的训练成本下，能够取得具有竞争力的结果。

articles.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation in the Agentic Era: Tradition, Present, and Prospect
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) couples frozen language models with external, updatable knowledge, so that generation is grounded in retrieved evidence rather than in parametric memory alone. This work maps RAG in the agentic era by joining them on a single lifecycle axis, from offline indexing through pre-retrieval, retrieval, post-retrieval, and orchestration over these stages. It treats indexing and orchestration as first-class components and agentic workflows as a paradigm of their own, and it covers the agentic work that has appeared since those reviews. Beyond these components, it covers evaluation, applications, and the questions that remain open for future exploration. From tradition to present and beyond, this work systematically reviews RAG from a perspective of the agentic era.
articles.titleCn: 智能体时代下的检索增强生成：传统、现状与展望
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）将冻结的语言模型与外部可更新的知识相结合，使得生成过程基于检索到的证据而非仅依赖参数化记忆。这项工作通过将它们置于单一的生命周期轴上，从离线索引到预检索、检索、后检索以及跨这些阶段的协调，将RAG映射到智能代理时代。它将索引和协调视为首要组件，并将智能代理工作流视为一种独立的范式，并涵盖了自那些评论以来出现的智能代理工作。除了这些组件之外，它还涵盖了评估、应用以及未来探索中仍悬而未决的问题。从传统到现代并展望未来，这项工作从智能代理时代的视角系统地回顾了RAG。

articles.title: FiRE: Fine-grained Ranking Evaluation for Machine Translation
articles.abstract: Developing reliable machine translation (MT) systems hinges on our ability to distinguish superior translations from inferior ones. However, existing evaluation paradigms, whether limited to coarse overall rankings or misaligned with human preferences, fail to deliver interpretable, fine-grained feedback in reference-free settings. We present a Fine-Grained Ranking Evaluation method (FiRE) that leverages off-the-shelf large language models to perform criterion-driven pairwise comparison across three complementary dimensions: faithfulness, fluency, and consistency of style, instead of producing a single holistic judgment. To enable rigorous meta-evaluation of evaluation paradigms in the absence of any suitable testbed, we construct the first human-annotated, reference-free benchmark for fine-grained ranking evaluation, achieving substantial inter-annotator agreement. Through meta-evaluation on this benchmark and existing MQM datasets, FiRE demonstrably outperforms regression-based and error-analysis metrics in aligning with human comparative judgments, while providing more informative insights into translation quality. Finally, our examination of LLM evaluator biases (position and self-enhancement) and their handling of tied cases offers guidance for more nuanced MT evaluation. Code and benchmark resources are available at https://github.com/wygao8/FiRE-MT.
articles.comment: 25 pages, 5 figures, accepted at ICML 2026. Wenyang Gao and Yinghao Yang contributed equally to this work. Our code is available at https://github.com/wygao8/FiRE-MT
articles.titleCn: FiRE：机器翻译的细粒度排序评估
articles.abstractCn: 开发可靠的机器翻译（MT）系统依赖于我们区分优质翻译与劣质翻译的能力。然而，现有的评估范式，无论是局限于粗略的整体排名还是与人类偏好不匹配，都无法在无参考设置下提供可解释的、细粒度的反馈。我们提出了一种细粒度排名评估方法（FiRE），该方法利用现成的语言模型在三个互补维度上进行标准驱动的成对比较：忠实度、流畅度和风格一致性，而不是做出单一的总体判断。为了在没有合适测试平台的情况下对评估范式进行严格的元评估，我们构建了首个用于细粒度排名评估的人工标注、无参考基准，实现了显著的标注者间一致性。通过对该基准和现有MQM数据集进行元评估，FiRE在与人比较判断的一致性方面明显优于基于回归和错误分析的指标，同时提供了更丰富的翻译质量洞察。最后，我们对语言模型评估者偏差（位置偏差和自我增强）及其处理平局情况的研究，为更细致的MT评估提供了指导。代码和基准资源可在https://github.com/wygao8/FiRE-MT获取。

articles.title: OpenViVE: New Benchmark and Dual-Stream Co-Attention Framework for Vietnamese Visual Entailment
articles.abstract: Visual Entailment (VE) determines whether a textual hypothesis is entailed, contradicted, or unverifiable from an image. However, existing VE benchmarks are largely English-centric and do not capture Vietnamese-specific linguistic distinctions or culturally grounded visual contexts. To address this gap, we introduce OpenViVE, the first large-scale native Vietnamese VE benchmark, containing 62,268 balanced image-hypothesis pairs from 10,378 culturally grounded images. OpenViVE is constructed using an Artifact-Aware Hybrid LLM-Human Pipeline that combines constrained generation, human validation, and PMI-guided refinement. The pipeline substantially reduces hypothesis-only shortcuts, with Contradiction accuracy dropping from 96% to 66% after artifact refinement. We further evaluate a dual-stream PhoBERT-ConvNeXt framework with bidirectional co-attention to align visual evidence with Vietnamese hypotheses. The framework achieves 84.84% accuracy and 84.90% macro-F1 on the test set, while PhoBERT consistently outperforms multilingual XLM-R variants. These results highlight the importance of language-specific encoding and explicit cross-modal interaction for Vietnamese VE.
articles.titleCn: OpenViVE：越南视觉蕴涵的新基准和双流协同注意力框架
articles.abstractCn: 视觉蕴涵（VE）旨在判断文本假设是否从图像中得出、矛盾或无法验证。然而，现有的VE基准主要针对英语，未能捕捉越南语特有的语言差异或基于文化的视觉语境。为填补这一空白，我们引入了OpenViVE，这是首个大规模越南语原生VE基准，包含来自10,378张基于文化的图像的62,268个平衡的图像-假设对。OpenViVE采用“文物感知混合LLM-人工流程”构建，该流程结合了约束生成、人工验证和PMI引导的优化。该流程显著减少了假设仅有的捷径，在文物优化后，矛盾准确率从96%降至66%。我们进一步评估了一个具有双向协同注意力的双流PhoBERT-ConvNeXt框架，以将视觉证据与越南语假设对齐。该框架在测试集上实现了84.84%的准确率和84.90%的宏观F1值，而PhoBERT始终优于多语言XLM-R变体。这些结果突显了针对越南语的特定编码和显式跨模态交互对于越南语VE的重要性。

articles.title: Reading the Tea Leaves, Again: Can Large Language Models Predict Language Model Training Runs?
articles.abstract: LLM agents now propose research ideas and run the experiments that test them, but they train every run to its end, whereas a researcher reads a run's configuration and the beginning of its curve and stops the runs that show no promise. Reading a run this way takes more than describing or implementing a training method: it takes knowing what a design choice does to a run. We build Tea Leaves to measure this knowledge on 682 real training runs across pretraining, fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning (RL): a forecaster sees the first 20% of a run with its configuration, description, and code, and predicts the rest. Across 11 LLMs and a range of forecasting baselines, the strongest LLMs match or exceed the best curve fitter on smooth loss curves (skill 0.66 against 0.62) and lead on noisy RL reward curves (0.43 against 0.13). What bounds every forecaster is what the log carries: on sparsely logged community runs all methods lose most of their skill, and none reliably flags a failing run in advance. Beyond the curve, information helps and effort does not: related runs in the prompt cut the error on loss curves by 39%, and knowledge of training dynamics lets the strongest LLMs order all 36 pairs of runs that differ by a described code change, which the early curves do not separate, whereas tools add little. This knowledge can be learned from logged runs: a small open model trained on public runs matches the best LLM on loss curves. Applied to the progress curves of research agents, the same reading ranks tasks by their remaining headroom, although for a single agent run it does not improve on the last value. We release the benchmark, the trained readers, and their training data to test and train LLMs' understanding of training and to help research agents decide which runs deserve their compute.
articles.comment: 63 pages, 9 figures, 40 tables; supplementary material (11 pages) as an ancillary file. Code and data: https://github.com/colinzhaoust/read-tea-leaves
articles.titleCn: 再读茶叶：大型语言模型能否预测语言模型训练过程？
articles.abstractCn: LLM智能体现在能够提出研究想法并运行实验来验证它们，但它们会训练每个运行直至结束，而研究人员会读取运行配置和曲线的开头，并停止那些没有前景的运行。以这种方式读取运行比描述或实现训练方法需要更多的知识：它需要了解设计选择对运行的影响。我们构建了Tea Leaves来衡量这种知识，在涵盖预训练、微调和强化学习（RL）的682个真实训练运行中：一个预测器看到运行的前20%，包括其配置、描述和代码，并预测其余部分。在11个LLM和一系列预测基线中，最强的LLM在平滑损失曲线上与最佳曲线拟合器相当或超过（技能0.66对比0.62），并在噪声RL奖励曲线上领先（0.43对比0.13）。所有预测器的限制在于日志记录的内容：在稀疏记录的社区运行中，所有方法都失去了大部分技能，且没有一种方法能可靠地提前标记出失败的运行。除了曲线之外，信息有助于而努力则无：提示中的相关运行将损失曲线的误差降低了39%，而关于训练动态的知识使最强的LLM能够对所有36对因描述的代码更改而不同的运行进行排序，而早期曲线无法区分，而工具则几乎无帮助。这种知识可以从记录的运行中学习：一个在公共运行上训练的小型开放模型在损失曲线上与最佳LLM相当。应用于研究智能体的进度曲线，同样的读取方法按任务的剩余空间排名，但对于单个智能体运行，它并不比最后值有所改进。我们发布了基准、训练的读取器和它们的训练数据，以测试和训练LLM对训练的理解，并帮助研究智能体决定哪些运行值得它们的计算资源。

articles.title: When Does Optical Context Compression Pay Off? A Decode-Aware Cost Analysis of Reasoning VLMs
articles.abstract: Rendering long text as images lets a vision-language model (VLM) read a document with fewer input tokens, and evaluations often count mainly these prefill tokens. We show that for reasoning models this accounting is incomplete. Across five models and two long-context benchmarks, reading the rendered document makes the model think longer: decode length grows by 1.5-3.5x on the four general-purpose VLMs tested, and under typical output pricing this decode tax makes image input more expensive than text for two of the five models on QuALITY. Unrecoverable information loss is not sufficient to explain the tax at moderate compression: Qwen's OCR of the same images recovers 98.7% of words, and feeding Kimi-K3 its own transcription as text restores text-mode reasoning length and accuracy. Whether compression pays off reduces to an exchange rate, (1-1/c)/(r-1), that must exceed the workload's price-weighted ratio of output to input tokens; this accounting decomposition shows why Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash can benefit and Qwen and GLM cannot. None of the training-free signals we test predicts the tax before generation. As a practical heuristic, an image-first policy that sends only inputs with a per-input compression ratio of at least 1.6 to images and falls back to text once image-mode reasoning costs as much as the input's prefill saving cuts the bill by 6-14% on Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at an accuracy cost of 0.3-1.2 points; on QuALITY, asking for a reasoning budget on both paths is a stronger lever.
articles.titleCn: 光学上下文压缩何时有效？推理视觉语言模型的解码感知成本分析
articles.abstractCn: 将长文本渲染为图像可以让视觉语言模型（VLM）用更少的输入token读取文档，评估通常主要计算这些预填充token。我们证明对于推理模型，这种计算是不完整的。在五个模型和两个长上下文基准测试中，读取渲染的文档使模型思考时间变长：在四个通用VLM上，解码长度增长了1.5-3.5倍，在典型输出计价下，这种解码成本使得图像输入在QuALITY上比文本更昂贵，对五个模型中的两个模型而言。不可恢复的信息损失不足以解释中等压缩率下的这种成本：Qwen对相同图像的OCR恢复了98.7%的单词，将Kimi-K3自己的转录文本输入后恢复了文本模式推理的长度和准确性。压缩是否划算归结为一个汇率（1-1/c）/（r-1），这个汇率必须超过工作负载的输出token与输入token的价格加权比率；这种计算分解显示了为什么Kimi-K3和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash能受益而Qwen和GLM不能。我们测试的所有无训练信号在生成前都无法预测这种成本。作为一种实用启发式方法，一种图像优先策略，将每输入压缩率至少为1.6的输入发送到图像，一旦图像模式推理成本与输入预填充节省相当就回退到文本，这种策略在Kimi-K3和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上节省了6-14%的成本，准确率损失为0.3-1.2分；在QuALITY上，要求在两条路径上都提供推理预算是一个更强的杠杆。

articles.title: Parameter-Efficient Vocabulary Expansion via Cross-Lingual Embedding Alignment
articles.abstract: Continual pretraining with vocabulary expansion is often used to make large language models (LLMs) more effective and efficient at handling new languages. However, when LLMs are extended to many languages simultaneously, the number of model parameters increases significantly. In addition, the newly added tokens do not receive the same number of training steps as the tokens in the original vocabulary, which sometimes causes vocabulary expansion to yield only limited performance improvements. We propose leveraging the semantic equivalence between words in the model's primary language and those in the extended vocabulary to transfer learned representations. In this paper, we introduce MATE, a parameter-efficient vocabulary expansion method that enables effective cross-lingual transfer with 8 times fewer additional parameters per token. MATE reduces the average tokenization compression ratio and delivers improvements on multiple benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: 基于跨语言嵌入对齐的参数高效词汇扩展
articles.abstractCn: 持续预训练结合词汇扩展常用于提升大型语言模型（LLMs）处理新语言的有效性和效率。然而，当LLMs同时扩展到多种语言时，模型参数数量会显著增加。此外，新增的token所接受的训练步数与原始词汇中的token不同，这有时会导致词汇扩展仅带来有限的性能提升。我们提出利用模型主要语言与扩展词汇中单词之间的语义等价性来迁移学习到的表示。在本文中，我们介绍了MATE，一种参数高效的词汇扩展方法，它能够在每个token上减少8倍的额外参数，实现有效的跨语言迁移。MATE降低了平均token化压缩率，并在多个基准测试中取得了改进。

articles.title: Character Information in Language Models: A Prompt-Independent Word Store and a Late, Question-Driven Signal That Grows With Scale
articles.abstract: Linear probes recover character properties of a word from a language model's hidden states, but a probe at the answer position cannot say whether the property was stored with the word or produced because the prompt asked for it. We separate the two with a word-position baseline: the same held-out-word probe applied to the query word's own tokens in a sentence that asks nothing. Across 16 open-weight models from seven families (0.6B--14B) and eleven character tasks, the word tokens encode \texttt{first\_letter}, \texttt{last\_letter} and \texttt{most\_frequent\_letter} above a word-only nuisance floor in all 16 models, and about 70\% of that signal is already present in the token embedding. Asking the question adds a second signal at the answer position. Its size grows with model scale for all four prompt-sensitive tasks (Holm-corrected permutation $p \leq 0.018$, also within model families), and the growth is confined to the late layers: restricted to the first quarter of the network, the slope is indistinguishable from zero. Small models' answer positions hold less linearly decodable signal than their word-level store; large models' hold more. Four controls bound these claims. Measured against the nuisance floor, the question-free signal that a majority-baseline analysis counts as retained largely disappears (\texttt{last\_letter}: $-0.01$). Count tasks become measurable only after length, repetition and query-letter shortcuts are removed by design. A pre-registered test finds that a question placed before the word does not change the word's own encoding beyond what an arbitrary prefix change does. Representation--readout gaps show no robust scaling once probe saturation is accounted for. Pre-registered criteria, a fixed estimator (held-out layer selection, cold-start folds) and all analysis code accompany the paper.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型中的角色信息：一个与提示无关的词存储库以及一个随规模增长、由问题驱动的后期信号
articles.abstractCn: 线性探针从语言模型的隐藏状态中恢复单词的特性，但位于答案位置的探针无法判断该特性是与单词本身存储相关，还是因为提示要求而生成。我们通过单词位置基线将两者区分开来：在询问无意义内容的句子中，将相同的保留单词探针应用于查询单词自身的标记。在来自七个系列（0.6B--14B）的16个开放权重模型和11个字符任务中，单词标记在所有16个模型中都编码了\texttt{first\_letter}、\texttt{last\_letter}和\texttt{most\_frequent\_letter}，并且该信号中有约70%已经存在于标记嵌入中。提问会增加答案位置的第二个信号。对于所有四个提示敏感任务（Holm校正置换$p \leq 0.018$，也在模型系列内部），该信号的大小随模型规模增长，并且这种增长仅限于晚期层：如果仅限于网络的前四分之一，其斜率与零无法区分。小型模型的答案位置比其单词级别的存储包含更少的线性可解码信号；大型模型则包含更多。四个控制实验验证了这些主张。与干扰基线相比，多数基线分析计为保留的无提示信号大部分消失（\texttt{last\_letter}: $-0.01$）。计数任务只有在通过设计移除长度、重复和查询字母捷径后才能被测量。一项预先注册的测试发现，将问题放在单词之前不会改变单词自身的编码，其影响等同于任意前缀的改变。一旦考虑探针饱和，表征-读出差距不再显示出稳健的缩放。论文附带了预先注册的标准、固定估计器（保留层选择、冷启动折叠）和所有分析代码。

articles.title: ESGPT: A Data-Centric ESG Language Model with Unified Instruction and Benchmark Resources
articles.abstract: ESG analysis requires complex language understanding across diverse sources, including corporate reports, news, and disclosures, for tasks such as ESG relevance detection, action interpretation, impact analysis, and question answering. However, existing ESG datasets are fragmented by task and source, with heterogeneous formats and annotation schemes, limiting their use for training general-purpose ESG LLMs and unified evaluation. In this work, we construct ESG-Instruct, a 30,000-instance ESG instruction dataset built from public ESG resources, and ESGU-Bench, an ESG understanding benchmark covering six representative ESG tasks. Based on these resources, we further develop ESGPT, an 8B ESG-specialized LLM, and evaluate it against diverse open-source and API-based LLMs. Experimental results show that general-purpose LLMs exhibit substantial performance variation across ESG tasks, while ESGPT, despite its relatively small scale, achieves the best performance on multiple ESG tasks. This work provides unified data and benchmark resources for training and evaluating ESG-specialized LLMs.
articles.titleCn: ESGPT：一个以数据为中心的ESG语言模型，具有统一的指令和基准资源
articles.abstractCn: ESG分析需要跨多种来源（包括企业报告、新闻和披露）进行复杂语言理解，以完成ESG相关性检测、行动解释、影响分析和问答等任务。然而，现有的ESG数据集因任务和来源而分散，格式和标注方案各异，限制了它们用于训练通用ESG大语言模型和统一评估。在本工作中，我们构建了ESG-Instruct，这是一个包含30,000个实例的ESG指令数据集，来源于公开的ESG资源，以及ESGU-Bench，一个涵盖六项代表性ESG任务的ESG理解基准。基于这些资源，我们进一步开发了ESGPT，一个8B参数的ESG专用大语言模型，并与其他多种开源和基于API的大语言模型进行了评估。实验结果表明，通用大语言模型在ESG任务上的表现差异显著，而ESGPT尽管规模相对较小，却在多项ESG任务上取得了最佳性能。这项工作为训练和评估ESG专用大语言模型提供了统一的数据和基准资源。

articles.title: STUN-Bench: Truly Unseen Tools for Evaluating Shared Tool Experience
articles.abstract: A tool router retrieves a few candidate tools per request and lets a language model choose. Methods that share experience across organizations add past requests about each tool to what the router retrieves. StableToolBench calls some of its test groups tests on "unseen" tools, yet the ToolBench instruction pool, which retrievers and experience-sharing methods learn from, contains every test query and labels every gold tool of the two single-tool groups among them. We release STUN-Bench (StableToolBench, Truly UNseen), a split whose experience pool has no item that labels or names 172 held-out tools. Unseen here means absent from shared experience and retriever training data, not from pretraining. On the split we find crowding: experience pooled from five simulated clients, added to an index of tool descriptions, outranks the descriptions of tools no client has used, which then often drop out of the candidate list. Under the Jina-v2 retriever, routing accuracy on held-out tools falls from 0.534 to 0.278. Retrievers trained for tool retrieval lose much less, and keeping experience in a separate index recovers most of the loss under Jina-v2. The split also reverses a conclusion: with every test tool labeled in the pool and our default leak filter applied, shared experience beats descriptions alone; on STUN-Bench it falls below them. The split, leak filter and evaluation harness are available at https://github.com/<org>/STUN-Bench.
articles.titleCn: STUN-Bench：用于评估共享工具体验的真实未见工具
articles.abstractCn: 一种工具路由器每次请求会检索少量候选工具，并让语言模型进行选择。跨组织共享经验的方法会将每个工具的过去请求信息添加到路由器检索的内容中。StableToolBench会将其部分测试组用于“未见”工具的测试，然而，路由器和经验共享方法所学习的路由器指令池中包含了所有测试查询，并对其中两个单工具组的每个黄金工具进行了标记。我们发布了STUN-Bench（StableToolBench，真正未见），这是一个其经验池中没有标记或命名172个保留工具的分割。这里的“未见”指的是缺失于共享经验和检索器训练数据中，而非预训练阶段。在这个分割上我们发现存在拥挤现象：从五个模拟客户端中汇集的经验，加上工具描述索引，其表现优于客户端未使用过的工具描述，这些描述随后常常从候选列表中排除。在Jina-v2检索器下，保留工具的路由准确率从0.534下降到0.278。为工具检索训练的检索器损失较小，将经验保存在单独索引中可在Jina-v2下恢复大部分损失。该分割还颠覆了一个结论：在池中标记每个测试工具并应用默认的泄漏过滤器时，共享经验优于单独描述；但在STUN-Bench上，其表现反而低于单独描述。该分割、泄漏过滤器和评估框架可在https://github.com/<org>/STUN-Bench获取。

articles.title: SHAKTI: Evidence-Grounded Conversational AI for Nutrition and Health
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) answer many diet and health questions but can state unsupported claims and cite sources that do not support them. We present SHAKTI (Smart Health Advisor for Knowledge-based Tailored Interventions), a conversational assistant that answers only from retrieved scholarly papers and exact food-composition data, and evaluate it with retrieval, generation, grounding, efficiency and contextawareness metrics. We indexed 484,368,086 OpenAlex works, searched exactly on a GPU for evaluation (10,065 NFCorpus, BioASQ, SciFact and PubMedQA questions) and through a compressed 230-million-abstract index in deployment. On 1,000 stratified questions, we compared single-shot, multi-hop, corrective and deep-research retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with Claude Sonnet. SHAKTI adds conversational query rewriting, USDA FoodData Central lookups, source-link checks and online verification of quotes and numbers. It was tested in 36 scripted conversational turns, a 248-question memory-depth test and a 38-question load test. Claims were checked by a Claude Opus judge against exactly the text the system saw. MedCPT reranking of hybrid retrieval gave the best MRR (0.21) and MAP@100 (0.14). Across existing RAG methods, faithfulness was 0.95-0.96, claim hallucination 0.5-0.8% and context precision up to 0.98; the deep-research agent answered 73.2% of BioASQ questions correctly. In conversation, SHAKTI reached a context-awareness score of 97.1%, faithfulness 95.5%, 1.9% unsupported claims, no contradicted claims and 229/229 working source links; it resolved references to the first question after 16 unrelated questions. An answer cost 14,716 tokens (US$0.06) with a median latency of 24 s. Large-scale retrieval with agentic evidence selection and mechanical verification yields auditable, low-hallucination nutrition answers.
articles.titleCn: SHAKTI：基于证据的饮食与健康对话式人工智能
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够回答许多饮食与健康相关的问题，但有时会提出未经证实的说法，并引用不支持这些说法的来源。我们提出了SHAKTI（基于知识的个性化干预智能健康顾问），这是一个仅从检索到的学术文献和精确的食物成分数据中回答问题的对话助手，并使用检索、生成、基础、效率和上下文感知等指标对其进行评估。我们索引了484,368,086篇OpenAlex文献，在评估中（10,065个NFCorpus、BioASQ、SciFact和PubMedQA问题）通过GPU进行精确搜索，并在部署中通过一个包含2.3亿摘要的压缩索引进行搜索。在1,000个分层问题的比较中，我们将单跳、多跳、纠正和深度研究检索增强生成（RAG）与Claude Sonnet进行了对比。SHAKTI增加了对话查询重写、USDA食品数据中央查询、来源链接检查以及引文和数字的在线验证。它在36个脚本对话回合、一个包含248个问题的记忆深度测试和一个包含38个问题的负载测试中进行了测试。声明由Claude Opus裁判根据系统所见的确切文本进行检查。混合检索的MedCPT重新排序给出了最佳的MRR（0.21）和MAP@100（0.14）。在现有的RAG方法中，忠实度为0.95-0.96，声明幻觉率为0.5-0.8%，上下文精确度高达0.98；深度研究代理正确回答了73.2%的BioASQ问题。在对话中，SHAKTI达到了97.1%的上下文感知得分、95.5%的忠实度、1.9%的未经证实的声明、没有矛盾的声明和229/229个有效的来源链接；在提出16个无关问题后，它解决了第一个问题的引用。回答成本为14,716个token（0.06美元），中位延迟为24秒。大规模检索结合代理证据选择和机械验证能够生成可审计、低幻觉的饮食答案。

articles.title: How Relations Impose Embedding-Space Structure
articles.abstract: Language models are known to encode simple relations, such as synonymy, in the geometry of their representations. It is unclear whether they also encode complex patterns of relationships such as those that drive analogy. We present a simple method, with no learned parameters, based on comparing the internal structural arrangements between disparate domains, to test this. Using our method we find over multiple models that representations are arranged consistently to encode complex relationship similarities. Models align distant representation clouds so that facets of meaning are easily comparable under simple mappings. Our work extends mechanistic accounts of representation space to the relative arrangement of representations that may be only weakly related to one another, showing that representation geometry is far richer than previously thought. Code and data: https://github.com/lcowley7/embedded_relationships
articles.titleCn: 关系如何强加嵌入空间结构
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型已知在它们的表示几何中编码简单关系，例如同义关系。尚不清楚它们是否也编码复杂的关系模式，例如驱动类比的那些关系。我们提出了一种简单的方法，该方法无需学习参数，基于比较不同领域之间的内部结构排列，来测试这一点。使用我们的方法，我们在多个模型中发现表示被一致地排列起来以编码复杂关系相似性。模型使遥远的表示云对齐，以便在简单的映射下，意义的各个方面可以轻松比较。我们的工作将表示空间的机制解释扩展到可能彼此只有弱关联的表示的相对排列，表明表示几何比以前认为的要丰富得多。代码和数据：https://github.com/lcowley7/embedded_relationships

articles.title: Language models seek help despite guaranteed score losses in question answering
articles.abstract: At the highest waiting cost in a multiple-choice question-answering task, all 7 tested open-weight language models still consult an expert even though a correct expert answer earns fewer points than an incorrect independent answer. Pooling over expert accuracy and fixed-fee combinations gives help-seeking rates of 20.8% to 94.1% across models. We test 2,291 questions across 54 combinations of expert accuracy and consultation costs, comparing observed decisions with an expected-score baseline based on independently measured and calibrated model confidence. Help-seeking rates vary across conditions with the same expected consultation score. Fine-tuning reduces decision regret by 59% to 87% on held-out questions within the training range but increases inconsistency at matched expected consultation scores. In a separate task, external routing improves scores by 0.180 to 0.273 points per question with candidate answers held fixed.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型在问答任务中即使保证会降低分数也寻求帮助
articles.abstractCn: 在多项选择题回答任务中，当等待成本最高时，所有7个测试的开权重语言模型仍然会咨询专家，即使正确的专家答案得分低于错误的独立答案。通过专家准确性和固定费用组合的池化，模型寻求帮助的比率在20.8%到94.1%之间。我们测试了2,291个问题，涵盖了54种专家准确性和咨询成本组合，将观察到的决策与基于独立测量和校准模型置信度的预期得分基线进行比较。在不同条件下，寻求帮助的比率在预期咨询得分相同的情况下有所变化。微调在训练范围内的保留问题上减少了59%到87%的决策遗憾，但在预期咨询得分匹配的情况下增加了不一致性。在一个单独的任务中，外部路由在候选答案固定的情况下，每题提高了0.180到0.273分。

articles.title: When 1+1 $\neq$ 2: Benchmarking Civil-Time Reasoning in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Calendar arithmetic is non-linear. When 1:59 AM + 1 minute occurs during daylight saving spring-forward, the result is 3:00 AM, not 2:00 AM, as the hour is skipped. We introduce CivilTime-Bench, a benchmark for civil-time reasoning covering daylight saving transitions, non-hour offsets, date-line crossings, and ISO week boundaries. With 60,011 training and 10,500 evaluation examples under strict output-contract evaluation, we benchmark seven LLMs (six instruction-tuned models and Llama-3.1-8B base) and find: zero-shot exact match varies substantially across models, contract-aware prompting often improves format compliance but yields inconsistent accuracy gains, few-shot in-context learning provides model-dependent improvements, and fine-tuning achieves 74.6--86.6% EM on synthetic evaluation but only 36.6--45.2% on HumanTime-500 for models with valid results on both splits, highlighting substantial limitations in generalization. We release the benchmark and code.
articles.comment: Accepted to Findings of EACL 2027. Code and dataset available at: https://github.com/CivilTime-Bench/CivilTime-Bench
articles.titleCn: 当1+1≠2：大型语言模型中的常识时间推理基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 日历运算是非线性的。在夏令时春季调快期间，当1:59 AM加上1分钟时，结果会是3:00 AM而不是2:00 AM，因为小时被跳过了。我们介绍了CivilTime-Bench，这是一个用于民用时间推理的基准，涵盖了夏令时转换、非整点偏移、日期线穿越以及ISO周边界。在严格的输出合同评估下，我们有60,011个训练样本和10,500个评估样本，对七个LLM（六个指令微调模型和Llama-3.1-8B基础模型）进行了基准测试，发现：零样本精确匹配在不同模型间差异显著，合同感知提示通常能提高格式合规性，但会带来不一致的准确率提升，少样本情境学习能提供模型相关的改进，而微调在合成评估上达到了74.6--86.6%的EM，但在HumanTime-500上仅为36.6--45.2%，对于在两个分割集上都有有效结果的模型，这凸显了泛化能力存在显著局限。我们发布了基准和代码。

articles.title: Tracing Attacker Diversity Reduction in Adaptive LLM Red Teaming
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning can increase the success of automated red teaming but it also narrows the attack vector. This study asks where in the attacker-defender-judge learning loop does the narrowing begin and which mechanisms lead to a narrowing attack. Six mechanisms (defender adaptation, success edge, reward reinforcement, row cap, update size, and measurement) are tested across three experiment arms (co-trained, frozen defender, half learning rate) for twenty-four iterations. A frozen defender narrows attack diversity retention (ADR) earlier 0.496 relative to co-trained 0.891 at iteration twelve. Defender updates delay narrowing but dont prevent it. Successful attacks ("winners") have narrower attack diversity than the full set of generated attacks. Attacks closest to previous winners succeed 10-15 percentage points more often than those closest to previous failures. This winner-neighbor advantage holds after a defender update and for a fixed defender too. Attacks with a common opening have a common-opening advantage of 5-16 percentage points. The training row cap and update size account for little impact on ADR, and attack length accounts for only part of the ADR decrease. Narrowing appears to originate from the success only reward through the group-relative training advantage to the attacker update, with a persistent success edge setting the direction.
articles.titleCn: 追踪自适应大型语言模型红队演练中攻击者多样性降低
articles.abstractCn: 强化学习可以提高自动化红队测试的成功率，但同时也缩小了攻击向量。本研究探讨了在攻击者-防御者-裁判学习循环中，缩小攻击向量是从何处开始的，以及哪些机制导致了攻击的缩小。通过三个实验组（协同训练、冻结防御者、学习率减半）对六种机制（防御者适应、成功边缘、奖励强化、训练行数上限、更新大小和测量）进行了二十四次迭代的测试。结果表明，冻结防御者在第十二次迭代时（0.496）比协同训练（0.891）更早地缩小了攻击多样性保留（ADR）。防御者更新会延迟缩小过程，但无法阻止其发生。成功攻击（“赢家”）的攻击多样性比所有生成的攻击要窄。与最近失败攻击相比，最接近最近赢家攻击的成功率高出10-15个百分点。这种赢家邻近优势在防御者更新后和固定防御者的情况下依然存在。具有相同开头的攻击具有5-16个百分点的共同开头优势。训练行数上限和更新大小对ADR的影响很小，而攻击长度仅解释了部分ADR下降。缩小现象似乎源于成功奖励机制，通过相对群体训练优势传递给攻击者更新，并由持续的成功边缘设定方向。

articles.title: Yggdrasil: Tree-Routed Recurrent Experts for State Tracking and Fast CPU Inference
articles.abstract: Parallel-trainable recurrences such as Mamba, linear attention, and DeltaNet offer constant-cost streaming inference, but they suffer from two limitations: 1) they struggle to track discrete state, and 2) they read every parameter at every step, tying model capacity directly to CPU latency. We introduce Yggdrasil, a recurrent architecture that decouples capacity from per-step compute by looking up each layer's transition in a large, tree-routed bank of recurrent experts. Each router addresses its bank using the current token and the state of the layer below. We prove that this cross-layer context is necessary---a single token-indexed layer of non-expanding transitions with finitely many reachable states cannot perform conditional resets---while avoiding feedback from the layer's own past preserves parallel-scan training. Because each step traverses one tree path and reads a single expert per layer, active weights stay within a few hundred kilobytes in CPU L2 cache while the full bank resides in RAM. Among the parallel-trainable models we evaluate, Yggdrasil is the only one to solve all five state-tracking tasks. At matched active parameter counts, it achieves the lowest test bits on enwik8 (1.540 bpb) and the human genome hg38 (1.567 bpb), while stepping $3.0\times$ and $3.3\times$ faster on a single CPU core ($6.7\,μ\mathrm{s}$ and $5.8\,μ\mathrm{s}$) than the fastest streaming baseline, and delivering the highest GPU throughput of all models at batch 1024. On the Genomic Benchmarks, it is the strongest causal model at matched active parameters (86.0% mean accuracy).
articles.titleCn: 伊格德拉西尔：用于状态跟踪和快速CPU推理的树形路由循环专家
articles.abstractCn: Mamba、线性注意力机制和DeltaNet等可并行训练的递归结构提供了恒定成本的流式推理，但它们存在两个局限性：1）难以追踪离散状态，2）每一步都读取所有参数，导致模型容量直接受CPU延迟的限制。我们引入了Yggdrasil，一种递归架构，通过在大型、树形路由的递归专家库中查找每一层的转换来将容量与每步计算解耦。每个路由器使用当前标记和下层状态来访问其专家库。我们证明这种跨层上下文是必要的——一个单标记索引的非扩展转换层，其可达状态有限，无法执行条件重置——同时避免从层自身的历史反馈可以保持并行扫描训练。由于每一步遍历一条树路径，并每层读取一个专家，因此活跃权重保持在CPU L2缓存中的几百KB内，而整个专家库驻留在RAM中。在我们评估的可并行训练模型中，Yggdrasil是唯一能解决所有五个状态追踪任务的模型。在匹配的活跃参数数量下，它在enwik8（1.540 bpb）和人类基因组hg38（1.567 bpb）上实现了最低的测试比特，同时在单个CPU核心上以3.0倍和3.3倍的速度比最快的流式基线更快（6.7μs和5.8μs），并在批处理1024时提供了所有模型中最高的GPU吞吐量。在基因组基准测试中，它在匹配的活跃参数下是因果模型中最强的（平均准确率86.0%）。

articles.title: The Answer Is Not the State: Trajectory-Level Corrigibility in Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models generate tokens at many positions on a shared canvas, making unfinished responses appear revisable. We find a counterexample: after the final answer is reopened, previously generated rationale can reconstruct the old decision despite newly available evidence. We isolate this effect by comparing reopening the answer alone with reopening both rationale and answer, and by exchanging rationales between paired trajectories. On a 150-question source-disjoint benchmark, reopening both regions makes decisions follow the evidence currently present--whether correct or deliberately corrupted--across Dream, LLaDA, and iLLaDA. On a new 100-question free-form short-answer evaluation, the same effect remains strong in LLaDA and iLLaDA but is negligible in Dream. Coherent transplanted rationales steer rebuilt decisions, while token-level attribution improves which positions to reopen without producing a compact repair. Corrigibility therefore depends on retained rationale state, not answer openness alone.
articles.titleCn: 答案并非状态：扩散语言模型中的轨迹级可纠正性
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型在共享画布上的多个位置生成标记，使得未完成的回复看起来可以修改。我们发现一个反例：在最终答案重新打开后，先前生成的推理过程可以重建旧决策，尽管有新的证据可用。我们通过比较仅重新打开答案与重新打开推理过程和答案，以及交换配对轨迹中的推理过程来隔离这种效应。在一个150个问题的源不连续基准测试中，重新打开两个区域使得决策遵循当前存在的证据——无论正确还是故意损坏——在Dream、LLaDA和iLLaDA中。在一个新的100个问题的自由形式简答题评估中，相同的效果在LLaDA和iLLaDA中仍然很强，但在Dream中可以忽略不计。连贯移植的推理过程引导重建的决策，而标记级别的归因改进了重新打开哪些位置，而不会产生紧凑的修复。因此，可纠正性取决于保留的推理状态，而不仅仅是答案的开放性。

articles.title: SAEPO: Sparse-Autoencoder-Guided Credit Assignment for Policy Optimization
articles.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has demonstrated strong performance in improving large language model (LLM) reasoning, yet its credit-assignment signal remains coarse. Outcome verifiers provide scalable supervision by judging whether a completed response is correct, but they do not directly indicate which intermediate reasoning tokens contribute to success or failure. As a result, policy optimization can be inefficient, especially when training base models directly from sparse outcome feedback. In this paper, we introduce SAEPO, a Sparse AutoEncoder-guided token-level credit assignment method for outcome-supervised Policy Optimization. Rather than treating correctness only as a rollout-level (sequence-level) signal, SAEPO uses a pretrained sparse autoencoder (SAE) to build token-level semantic representations within reasoning trajectories; it scores each token based on the SAE concepts (e.g., penalizing wrong "final-answer" tokens but rewarding correct "reasoning-process" tokens), learned in an unsupervised manner, to achieve fine-grained credit assignment. SAEPO is a plug-in advantage-shaping module compatible with various policy optimization algorithms. We instantiate SAEPO with both GRPO and GSPO, covering token-ratio and sequence-ratio policy-gradient objectives, and evaluate SAEPO across three LLM backbones on six math and two code benchmarks. Empirical results show that SAEPO improves both the math and code benchmark averages over the matched baselines, with gains of up to 6.63% and 5.57%, respectively. On Qwen3-1.7B-Base, training curves also show faster early accuracy growth. Feature and token-level analyses suggest that the SAE-derived signal favors question-relevant concepts and reasoning tokens.
articles.titleCn: SAEPO：用于策略优化的稀疏自编码器引导信用分配
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）在提升大型语言模型（LLM）推理能力方面表现出色，但其信用分配信号仍然较为粗糙。结果验证器通过判断完成的响应是否正确提供可扩展的监督，但它们并未直接指出哪些中间推理标记对成功或失败做出贡献。因此，策略优化可能效率低下，尤其是在直接从稀疏结果反馈中训练基础模型时。在本文中，我们引入了SAEPO，一种用于结果监督策略优化的稀疏自编码器引导的标记级信用分配方法。SAEPO不仅将正确性视为一个回合级（序列级）信号，而是利用预训练的稀疏自编码器（SAE）在推理轨迹中构建标记级语义表示；它根据SAE概念（例如，惩罚错误的“最终答案”标记，但奖励正确的“推理过程”标记）进行评分，这些概念以无监督方式学习，以实现细粒度的信用分配。SAEPO是一个可与各种策略优化算法兼容的插件式优势塑造模块。我们使用GRPO和GSPO实例化SAEPO，涵盖了标记比和序列比策略梯度目标，并在三个LLM主干模型上对六个数学和两个代码基准评估SAEPO。实证结果表明，SAEPO在匹配基线上的数学和代码基准平均得分均有提升，分别提高了高达6.63%和5.57%。在Qwen3-1.7B-Base上，训练曲线也显示出更快的早期准确率增长。特征和标记级分析表明，SAE衍生的信号倾向于支持与问题相关的概念和推理标记。

articles.title: Training-Free Interventions for Hallucination in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: A frozen language model can give a wrong answer because a fact is unavailable, a reliable passage is ignored, or an unsupported claim survives generation. We review 116 works on inference-time hallucination intervention and its foundations. We trace the development from retrieval and controllable generation to methods that act on input evidence, token scores, internal representations, completed claims, or the decision to answer. For each family we compare its source of evidence, model access, preparation cost, and the task on which a correction can be established. For activation steering, we distinguish estimating a subspace from applying a state-dependent edit and separate interventions on the prompt from those on the generated prefix. Published comparisons show why faithfulness to a source, factual correctness, informativeness, and answer coverage must be measured separately. Applications in time-sensitive question answering, document synthesis, and visual grounding identify when source authority, evidence availability, or capability preservation limits a reported gain.
articles.titleCn: 针对大型语言模型的幻觉问题的无训练干预措施
articles.abstractCn: 一个冻结的语言模型可能会因为事实不可用、可靠文本被忽略或不受支持的声明得以生成而给出错误答案。我们回顾了关于推理时幻觉干预及其基础的116项研究。我们追溯了从检索和控制生成到作用于输入证据、标记分数、内部表示、已完成声明或回答决策的方法的发展历程。对于每个类别，我们比较了其证据来源、模型访问方式、准备成本以及在何种任务上可以建立纠正。在激活引导方面，我们区分了估计子空间与应用状态相关编辑，并将对提示的干预与对生成前缀的干预分开。已发表的对比研究表明，为何忠实度、事实准确性、信息量和答案覆盖率必须分别衡量。在时间敏感型问答、文档合成和视觉定位等应用中，我们确定了何时权威性来源、证据可用性或能力保留会限制所报告的收益。

articles.title: Escriba-OCR: A 1B Vision-Language Model for Error-Preserving Transcription of Handwritten Portuguese Essays
articles.abstract: Feedback tools and research on learner writing need transcriptions of handwritten essays that keep exactly what the student wrote: misspellings, line breaks, struck-through words and insertions. Vision-language models (VLMs) read handwriting well, but they also tend to rewrite it into correct language. We measure this on BRESSAY, 1,000 handwritten Brazilian Portuguese essays, with a benchmark that adds error preservation, invented errors, edit-markup precision and recall and line structure to the character error rate (CER) and uses paired bootstrap confidence intervals. We restrict the study to open-weight models that schools can run on their own hardware. Of 22 open baselines, the best, Qwen3-VL 235B-A22B, reaches 5.6% CER on the 199 test pages; none reproduces the edit markup reliably, and every VLM replaces 39-78% of the words absent from a Portuguese dictionary with dictionary words. We fine-tune LightOnOCR-3-1B on the 647 training pages in 85 minutes on one GPU. The resulting Escriba-OCR-1B reaches 2.06% CER, 3.5 points below the best baseline (95% CI [-4.2, -2.9]); under the ICDAR 2024 competition metric it reaches 2.1% CER, below the best published page-level results (2.2-2.4%). It recovers 67% of insertions and 77% of illegible deletions, and reproduces the line structure of 97% of the pages, but still normalises 60% of likely misspellings. Three seeds agree within 0.04 CER points, and quantised to 4 bits the model runs on an ordinary CPU at about one minute per page. On 40 letters of another corpus it matches its base model (without that model's appended comments) but misreads unseen words more often; weight interpolation recovers half the gap. A teacher's review finds that 45% of the judgeable apparent corrections are errors in the BRESSAY ground truth, so dictionary-based scores likely understate preservation. We release the model, the benchmark code and the review data.
articles.comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Model: https://huggingface.co/tardellirs/Escriba-OCR-1B ; code and benchmark: https://github.com/tardellirs/escriba-ocr
articles.titleCn: Escriba-OCR：一个用于手写葡萄牙语文章错误保留转录的1B视觉语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 反馈工具和关于学习者写作的研究需要能够保留学生真实书写的作文转录，包括拼写错误、换行、划掉的字和插入的内容。视觉语言模型（VLMs）虽然能很好地识别手写文字，但往往将其改写成正确的语言。我们在BRESSAY数据集上进行了测量，该数据集包含1,000篇葡萄牙语手写作文，并使用了一个基准指标，该指标在字符错误率（CER）的基础上增加了错误保留、虚构错误、编辑标记的精确度和召回率以及行结构。我们仅研究学校可以在其硬件上运行的开放权重模型。在22个开放基线模型中，最好的模型Qwen3-VL 235B-A22B在199页测试文档上达到了5.6%的CER；没有模型能可靠地重现编辑标记，并且每个VLM都将葡萄牙语词典中不存在的39-78%的词替换为词典中的词。我们在一个GPU上用85分钟对LightOnOCR-3-1B进行了微调。生成的Escriba-OCR-1B模型达到了2.06%的CER，比最佳基线低3.5个百分点（95%置信区间[-4.2, -2.9]）；在ICDAR 2024竞赛指标下，它达到了2.1%的CER，低于已发表的页面级最佳结果（2.2-2.4%）。它恢复了67%的插入内容和77%的难以辨认的删除内容，并重现了97%的页面行结构，但仍然将60%的可能拼写错误标准化了。三个种子在0.04 CER点内一致，量化到4位后，模型在普通CPU上每页运行约需一分钟。在另一个语料库的40个字母上，它与其基础模型（不包括该模型附加的评论）匹配，但更频繁地误读未知的词；权重插值弥补了其中一半的差距。一位教师的评审发现，BRESSAY真实数据中45%的裁判认为的“修正”实际上是错误，因此基于词典的评分可能低估了保留效果。我们发布了模型、基准代码和评审数据。

articles.title: GlobalHRBench: Does Changing the Question Language Change the Legal Answer?
articles.abstract: Language matters when deploying LLM agents across borders, especially in law, where the governing rules must hold across working languages. Does changing the language of a legal question change answer accuracy? We introduce GlobalHRBench, pairing 240 employment-law problems across eight jurisdictions and eight languages while fixing facts, applicable law and required conclusions. We evaluate nine models on all 1,920 prompts in independent, closed-book, single-answer trials, scoring legal correctness, completeness and answer-language compliance. GPT-6.1 Sol leads at 76.2% strict passes, with a 5.8% relative best-to-worst language decline, compared with 42.2% for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Kimi K3.1 Pro and Claude Sonnet 5.5 reverse order between English and Chinese. A four-model study on 16 paired families compares closed-book answers with governing evidence, added cross-jurisdiction distractors and removal of a governing passage. Governing evidence corrects legal errors and shortens reasoning on recovered answers, yet recognizing an evidence gap does not ensure correct application of the rules that remain. These findings motivate multilingual training for accurate, efficient and evidence-supported answers, and deployment evaluation in the user's working language.
articles.titleCn: GlobalHRBench：更改问题语言是否会影响法律答案？
articles.abstractCn: 在跨国部署大型语言模型代理时，语言至关重要，尤其是在法律领域，其中管辖规则必须在工作语言中保持一致。改变法律问题的语言会改变答案的准确性吗？我们介绍了GlobalHRBench，它将240个劳动法问题配对，覆盖八个司法管辖区和八种语言，同时固定事实、适用法律和所需结论。我们在所有1,920个提示中独立、闭卷、单答案试验中评估了九个模型，评分法律正确性、完整性和答案语言合规性。GPT-6.1 Sol以76.2%的严格通过率领先，与DeepSeek V4.1 Flash的42.2%相比，相对最佳至最差语言下降5.8%。Kimi K3.1 Pro和Claude Sonnet 5.5在英语和中文之间逆转顺序。一项涉及16对家庭的四模型研究比较了闭卷答案与管辖证据、增加跨司法管辖区干扰项以及移除管辖段落。管辖证据纠正了法律错误并缩短了恢复答案的推理时间，但认识到证据差距并不能保证正确适用剩余的规则。这些发现推动了多语言训练，以实现准确、高效和有证据支持的答案，并在用户的工作语言中进行部署评估。

articles.title: The Temporal Residual: Fast and Effective Retrofitting of Latent Feedback into Pretrained Language Models
articles.abstract: A transformer language model computes a deep hidden state for every token but uses it only to sample that token. Existing latent-feedback designs, which feed hidden states back across tokens, are mostly built in during pretraining and gain little when added to a pretrained model. We introduce the temporal residual, a second residual stream that every sublayer reads and writes and that is carried from each token to the next. It adds 2,752 parameters to a 4.2B-parameter model and starts exactly at the pretrained network. Retrofitted onto Qwen3.5-4B-Base with 5B tokens of training, it beats a standard model trained on the same data by 7, 13 and 5 points on AIME 2024, AIME 2025 and AMC 2023, writes shorter solutions, and stays ahead at matched training compute. The separate stream matters: prior designs that feed state into the existing stream recover at most 40% of the gain when retrofitted. Validation loss can mislead: the recipe with the lowest loss gains nothing at decoding. Trained with filler tokens in place of reasoning, the model reasons in its hidden state: its GSM8K accuracy with no visible reasoning rises from 21% to 40%, and falls back when the carried state is zeroed.
articles.titleCn: 时序残差：快速有效的将潜在反馈重构到预训练语言模型中
articles.abstractCn: Transformer语言模型为每个token计算一个深度隐藏状态，但仅使用该状态来采样该token。现有的潜反馈设计，这些设计将隐藏状态跨token传递，大多是在预训练阶段构建的，在预训练模型上添加时几乎没有收益。我们引入了时间残差，这是一个第二层残差流，每个子层都读取和写入该流，并且从每个token传递到下一个token。它为42亿参数的模型增加了2,752个参数，并从预训练网络开始。在Qwen3.5-4B-Base上添加5亿个训练token后，它在AIME 2024、AIME 2025和AMC 2023上分别比在相同数据上训练的标准模型提高了7、13和5个百分点，写出了更短的解决方案，并在匹配训练计算中保持领先。单独的流很重要：先前的将状态输入现有流的设计在添加后最多只能恢复40%的收益。验证损失可能具有误导性：具有最低损失的配方在解码时没有收益。用填充token代替推理进行训练时，模型在其隐藏状态中进行推理：其GSM8K准确率在没有可见推理的情况下从21%提高到40%，当传递状态被清零时又回落。
